AI.theoretical_framework: 医疗废物管理理论、环境健康理论、知识-态度-实践(KAP)框架
AI.method: 横断面研究，采用定性和定量混合方法，通过访谈、观察、文件审查和问卷调查从12家医疗机构收集数据
AI.findings: 1) 每日产生2.8吨医疗废物，其中22%为危险废物；2) 废物处置能力不足；3) 不当处置方法危害废物处理人员健康并导致环境退化；4) 医护人员知识、态度和实践存在差距
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 为发展中国家城市医疗废物管理提供实证证据；2) 验证了知识-态度-实践框架在医疗废物管理中的应用；3) 揭示了制度实施与实际行动之间的差距
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 建议加强国家指南实施；2) 提供医护人员额外培训；3) 建立高效废物管理系统；4) 为基于证据的政策决策提供依据；5) 强调协调应对的重要性

title: Performance Attribution: the Harsanyi Method
affiliations: Risknowledge SA, Corvinus University of Budapest and Tilburg University

detail.title: Performance Attribution: the Harsanyi Method
detail.abstract: We introduce a general principle-based approach to performance attribution. Our framework defines a performance attribution problem by incorporating decision makers, feasible actions capturing ex-post realizations, benchmarks, and a general return function. We propose the Harsanyi attribution function, rooted in cooperative game theory, to allocate excess returns among all possible teams of decision makers. Attributions to coalitions provide a full description of attributions to single decision makers as well as team interaction effects resulting from the joint effects of multiple decision makers, thereby breaking down performance into a full chart of mutual interactions. We characterize the Harsanyi attribution function axiomatically and prove that it is the unique coalition attribution method satisfying efficiency, outsider independence, and null contribution. Efficiency requires that the full excess return should be attributed. Outsider independence means that a team's attribution remains unaffected by the actions of any external decision maker. Null contribution ensures that a team containing a decision maker who selects the benchmark action gets zero attribution. To enhance computational efficiency, we establish three key theorems that significantly reduce computational complexity and improve practical implementation. Finally, we prove that the Harsanyi method is compatible with respect to aggregation of decisions, in the sense  that if the decisions of a team are transferred to a single decision maker, this will inherit exactly the sum of the attributions related to the team's members.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于原则的绩效归因通用框架，采用合作博弈论中的Harsanyi归因函数，将超额收益分配给所有可能的决策者团队，并分解出个体贡献和团队互动效应。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个通用、原则性的绩效归因框架，能够全面分解超额收益到各个决策者及其团队互动效应？
AI.motivation: 现有绩效归因方法往往缺乏理论基础，难以全面捕捉决策者之间的互动效应，需要建立一个基于原则的通用框架来解决这一问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于合作博弈理论，特别是Harsanyi价值函数，构建绩效归因的理论框架，包含决策者、可行行动、基准和收益函数等核心要素。
AI.method: 提出Harsanyi归因函数，通过公理化方法（效率性、外部独立性、零贡献性）进行理论刻画，并建立三个关键定理降低计算复杂度。
AI.findings: Harsanyi归因函数是唯一满足效率性、外部独立性和零贡献性的联盟归因方法，能够全面分解绩效到个体和团队互动效应，且具有决策聚合兼容性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 建立了基于合作博弈论的绩效归因理论框架；2) 公理化刻画了Harsanyi归因函数的唯一性；3) 证明了决策聚合兼容性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 提供可操作的绩效分解工具；2) 降低计算复杂度的实用定理；3) 支持团队互动效应分析，有助于组织设计和激励机制优化。

title: Corporate Values of TNCS as a Sociocultural Resource for Developing Foreign Language Competence of International Affairs Specialists
affiliations: Moscow State Institute of International Relations (MGIMO)

detail.title: Corporate Values of TNCS as a Sociocultural Resource for Developing Foreign Language Competence of International Affairs Specialists
detail.abstract: The paper argues the didactic potential of analyzing value systems of transnational corporations (TNCs) as a sociocultural resource for developing professional foreign language communicative competence in international affairs students. Corporate values – articulated in mission statements, codes of conduct, and ESG reports – are examined as authentic texts of the transnational cultural field, where universal corporate standards encounter locally embedded cultural practices. Practical integration methods are proposed: work with corporate documents, Hofstede-based comparative analysis, intercultural situation simulation, and critical discourse analysis. The approach fosters reflective capacity, adaptive communicative behavior, and appreciation of value conflicts in global business. The methodology combines philosophical-anthropological analysis of corporate cultures with foreign language teaching theory (FLT).

AI.tldr: 本文探讨分析跨国公司价值体系作为培养国际事务学生专业外语交际能力的社会文化资源的教学潜力。通过研究企业使命宣言、行为准则和ESG报告等真实文本，结合霍夫斯泰德文化比较分析、跨文化情境模拟和批判性话语分析等方法，提升学生的反思能力、适应性交际行为和对全球商业价值冲突的理解。
AI.research_question: 如何利用跨国公司价值体系分析作为发展国际事务学生专业外语交际能力的社会文化资源？
AI.motivation: 传统外语教学往往忽视专业领域的文化维度，而跨国公司价值体系作为真实的社会文化资源，能够帮助学生理解全球商业环境中的文化冲突和适应性问题，从而提升专业外语交际能力。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 哲学人类学视角下的企业文化分析
2. 外语教学理论（FLT）
3. 霍夫斯泰德文化维度理论
4. 批判性话语分析理论
5. 跨文化交际理论
AI.method:
1. 企业文档分析（使命宣言、行为准则、ESG报告）
2. 基于霍夫斯泰德理论的比较文化分析
3. 跨文化情境模拟
4. 批判性话语分析
5. 哲学人类学与企业文化分析相结合的方法论
AI.findings:
跨国公司价值体系分析能够有效：
1. 提升学生的反思能力
2. 培养适应性交际行为
3. 增强对全球商业价值冲突的理解和欣赏
4. 将普遍性企业标准与地方性文化实践相结合
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 将跨国公司价值体系概念化为外语教学的社会文化资源
2. 建立哲学人类学分析与外语教学理论的跨学科框架
3. 拓展专业外语交际能力的文化维度理解
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 提供具体的教学整合方法（文档分析、文化比较、情境模拟）
2. 为国际事务专业外语教学开发实用教学策略
3. 帮助学生更好地适应全球化商业环境中的跨文化交际挑战

title: China's Central-Local Governments and Corporate Collaboration to Reduce Poverty: A Multi-Agency Perspective
affiliations: National University of Singapore (NUS), National University of Singapore (NUS) - Department of Business Policy and National University of Singapore (NUS) - NUS Business School

detail.title: China's Central-Local Governments and Corporate Collaboration to Reduce Poverty: A Multi-Agency Perspective
detail.abstract: Multi-agent settings are pervasive in organizations and public policy. Itoh's (1991) teamwork model explains how incentive design induces cooperation and mutual monitoring when agents jointly produce outcomes. In China's poverty reduction, no single actor had sufficient resources; effective action required collaboration between local governments and corporations with divergent objectives. Drawing on Itoh's framework, we analyze how the central government aligned incentives to coordinate these actors. Corporate tax deductions were tied to verified local poverty data and policy mandates, while firms' initiatives advanced local governments' social performance targets. Monitoring was embedded in the system: local governments approved deductions, and state-owned enterprises exerted oversight pressure, generating reciprocal accountability. This integrated reward-and-monitoring architecture mitigated freeriding and facilitated sustained cooperation, thereby accelerating poverty alleviation. Beyond this context, the analysis clarifies how teamwork-based incentive alignment can address grand challenges in strategic management and public governance that require coordinated action across heterogeneous agents.

AI.tldr: 基于Itoh团队合作模型，分析中国政府如何通过税收激励和相互监督机制协调地方政府与企业，共同推动扶贫工作，为解决跨部门协作的宏大挑战提供理论框架。
AI.research_question: 在中国扶贫背景下，中央政府如何通过激励机制设计协调地方政府与企业这两个目标不同的主体，实现有效的跨部门合作？
AI.motivation: 组织与公共政策中普遍存在多主体协作问题，中国扶贫工作中单一主体资源不足，需要协调目标不同的地方政府与企业，这为研究激励机制设计提供了现实场景。
AI.theoretical_framework: Itoh（1991）的团队合作模型，该模型解释了激励机制如何诱导合作与相互监督，特别是当代理人共同产出结果时。
AI.method: 基于Itoh理论框架，分析中国扶贫政策中的激励机制设计，特别是企业税收抵扣与地方政府绩效目标的关联机制。
AI.findings: 中央政府通过将企业税收抵扣与地方扶贫数据验证和政策任务挂钩，同时企业举措推动地方政府社会绩效目标，形成整合的奖励-监督架构。地方政府审批抵扣，国有企业施加监督压力，产生相互问责，有效减少搭便车行为，促进持续合作。
AI.theory_contributions: 将Itoh团队合作模型应用于公共治理领域，阐明基于团队合作的激励机制如何协调异质性主体，为解决战略管理和公共治理中的宏大挑战提供理论见解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为中国及其他国家的跨部门协作政策设计提供实践指导，展示了如何通过整合的奖励和监督机制促进地方政府与企业合作，加速扶贫等社会目标的实现。

title: From National to European - And Back Again: Fixing the Flaws of the New Approach
affiliations: Utrecht School of Law

detail.title: From National to European - And Back Again: Fixing the Flaws of the New Approach
detail.abstract:
Harmonized standards are central to European policymaking. Traditionally intended to ensure technical harmonization and consumer safety, harmonized standards are increasingly becoming critical for regulating many societal aspects: to illustrate, the recently adopted AI Act outsources many legal and ethical decisions to the European standards bodies. In this setting, questions whether and how public interest is sufficiently safeguarded in the private setting of European standardizations are bound to arise.

Developed mainly by commercial entities, harmonized standards are under little – if any – control of civil society. Firstly, participation of societal stakeholders in technical standardization processes remains limited; secondly, despite the recent jurisprudence, access to harmonized standards remains challenging. Academic and policy discussions on these issues abound; however, the role of Member States, and more specifically National Standards Organizations in ensuring participation in and access to standards, tends to be sidestepped.

This paper examines two key transparency challenges posed by the New Approach: access to standardization processes and access to harmonized standards. It argues that although these issues are essentially European, their resolution depends on national institutions, which poses questions regarding the interplay between national and European accountability in standardization. Ultimately, it suggests possible solution to these challenges, placing them in the broader context of European standardization policy

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨欧洲协调标准制定中的透明度挑战，特别是公众参与标准化过程和获取标准文件的问题，认为虽然这是欧洲层面的问题，但解决方案依赖于国家机构，需要平衡国家与欧洲的问责机制。
AI.research_question: 在欧盟协调标准制定中，如何确保公众利益得到充分保障？具体而言，如何解决标准化过程的参与不足和标准文件获取困难这两个透明度挑战？
AI.motivation: 协调标准在欧盟政策制定中日益重要，不仅涉及技术协调和消费者安全，还扩展到法律和伦理决策（如AI法案）。然而，这些主要由商业实体制定的标准缺乏公民社会的监督，存在参与不足和获取困难的问题，而成员国和各国标准组织的作用常被忽视。
AI.theoretical_framework: 欧盟标准化政策理论、公私治理理论、透明度与问责理论、多层次治理理论（欧洲与国家层面的互动）
AI.method: 政策分析、法律分析、案例研究（以AI法案为例）、制度分析（欧洲标准化机构与各国标准组织的角色）
AI.findings: 1. 协调标准制定过程中公民社会参与有限；2. 尽管有近期司法判例，获取标准文件仍然困难；3. 这些透明度挑战本质上是欧洲问题，但解决方案依赖于国家机构；4. 需要平衡国家与欧洲层面的问责机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 深化对欧盟标准化中多层次治理的理解；2. 探讨公私治理中透明度与问责的理论框架；3. 分析标准化过程中公众参与的理论基础；4. 提出国家机构在解决欧洲标准化问题中的理论角色。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为欧盟标准化政策改革提供建议；2. 提出改善标准化过程参与的具体措施；3. 建议解决标准文件获取困难的方案；4. 明确各国标准组织在保障公众利益中的实践角色；5. 为AI法案等具体政策的实施提供参考。

title: Separation of Bases and the Fiscal Constitution
affiliations: New York University School of Law and University of San Diego School of Law

detail.title: Separation of Bases and the Fiscal Constitution
detail.abstract:
A central concern of constitutional law and theory is the question of tax assignment: In a multilevel system of government, who gets to tax what? One conventional answer invokes the "separation of bases," according to which constitutions should assign each tax base exclusively to one level of government. Proponents justify separation on two grounds: It prevents excessive taxation (the efficiency rationale), and it protects states from federal encroachment (the federalism rationale). These arguments have a centuries-long lineage in Anglo-American political economy and continue to feature prominently in constitutional litigation today. 

This Article proposes a new account of tax assignment, one that reveals the conventional wisdom to be not only incomplete but, in key respects, backward. With regard to efficiency, we show that separating bases often forgoes significant synergies that arise when enforcement by one level of government facilitates tax collection by the other. With respect to federalism, we demonstrate through a game-theoretic model that constraints on Congress's tax powers can confer a strategic advantage on the federal government in bargaining with the states--the opposite of the standard view, which posits that limits on federal tax authority redound to the states' benefit. 

These insights yield a new normative prescription for allocating tax authority in federal systems, which we call the "relative externalities principle." According to that standard, separation of bases is optimal only when the negative externality from two governments overgrazing the same base exceeds the positive externality from both governments bolstering each other's enforcement efforts. Our analysis also casts fresh light on the Direct Tax Clauses of the U.S. Constitution, which potentially curb Congress's ability to tax property but--counterintuitively--strengthen the federal government's hand in intergovernmental bargaining. Beyond the federal Constitution, our framework offers insight into the design of state constitutions, the ongoing debate over the state and local tax deduction, and the architecture of international tax cooperation.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了税收分配的传统"税基分离"观点，提出新的"相对外部性原则"，认为税基共享可能比分离更有效，并揭示联邦税收限制可能反而增强联邦政府在博弈中的优势。
AI.research_question: 在多层政府体系中，如何最优分配税收权力？传统的"税基分离"原则是否真的能实现效率和联邦主义目标？
AI.motivation: 传统宪法理论和实践普遍采用"税基分离"原则，认为每个税基应专属分配给某一级政府，以防止过度征税和保护州权。但这一传统智慧可能存在根本缺陷。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 税基分离理论（传统观点）：效率理据（防止过度征税）和联邦主义理据（保护州权）
2. 博弈论模型：分析联邦与州政府间的战略互动
3. 外部性理论：正外部性（执法协同效应）与负外部性（过度征税）的权衡
4. 相对外部性原则：新的规范性标准
AI.method: 理论分析结合博弈论建模，通过逻辑推理和模型构建挑战传统观点，并应用于美国宪法条款和实际政策问题。
AI.findings:
1. 税基分离会放弃重要的执法协同效应
2. 对国会税收权力的限制可能反而增强联邦政府在博弈中的战略优势
3. 只有当负外部性（过度征税）超过正外部性（执法协同）时，税基分离才是最优的
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出"相对外部性原则"作为税收分配的新规范性标准
2. 挑战了传统税基分离理论的效率和联邦主义理据
3. 为理解美国宪法直接税条款提供了新视角
4. 建立了税收分配问题的博弈论分析框架
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为美国宪法解释提供新视角
2. 对州宪法设计有指导意义
3. 为州和地方税收扣除的持续辩论提供分析框架
4. 对国际税收合作架构有启示

title: What Drives Automation? Evidence from a Macro-Consistent Measure of Automation
affiliations: Osaka Metropolitan University and Osaka Metropolitan University

detail.title: What Drives Automation? Evidence from a Macro-Consistent Measure of Automation
detail.abstract: This paper studies the labor-market and trade determinants of automation using a macro-consistent measure developed by Nakamura et al. (2026). Automation is defined as the equilibrium share of production tasks performed by capital rather than labor. Using panel data for 52 Japanese manufacturing industries over 1994--2020, we show that automation responds positively to relative labor costs, consistent with task-based models, and that the strength of these responses varies with workforce composition and trade exposure. In particular, industries experiencing larger increases in the share of part-time workers exhibit significantly faster automation growth, while trade exposure further amplifies these effects. By contrast, specifications based on robot intensity yield insignificant coefficients, indicating that equilibrium-based measures of automation capture systematic economic relationships that are not fully captured by technology-specific proxies.

AI.tldr: 本文使用 Nakamura 等人 (2026) 开发的宏观一致性指标，研究了劳动力市场和贸易对自动化的决定因素。基于日本52个制造业行业1994-2020年的面板数据，发现自动化对相对劳动力成本呈正向响应，且这种响应强度随劳动力构成和贸易开放度而变化。兼职员工比例增加越大的行业自动化增长越快，贸易开放进一步放大这些效应。相比之下，基于机器人密度的指标不显著。
AI.research_question: 劳动力市场和贸易因素如何影响自动化？自动化对相对劳动力成本、劳动力构成和贸易开放度的响应机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 现有研究多使用机器人密度等技术特定代理变量来衡量自动化，但这些指标可能无法捕捉系统性的经济关系。需要开发宏观一致的自动化衡量方法，以更好地理解劳动力市场和贸易对自动化的决定因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于任务模型理论，自动化被定义为资本而非劳动力执行生产任务的均衡份额。该框架强调相对要素价格（特别是劳动力成本）对自动化决策的影响。
AI.method: 使用 Nakamura 等人 (2026) 开发的宏观一致性自动化衡量指标，基于日本52个制造业行业1994-2020年的面板数据进行实证分析。采用计量经济学方法检验自动化对相对劳动力成本、劳动力构成和贸易开放度的响应。
AI.findings: 1. 自动化对相对劳动力成本呈正向响应，符合任务模型预测；2. 兼职员工比例增加越大的行业自动化增长越快；3. 贸易开放进一步放大劳动力构成对自动化的影响；4. 基于机器人密度的指标不显著，表明均衡性自动化指标能捕捉更系统的经济关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 验证了任务模型在解释自动化决策方面的适用性；2. 揭示了劳动力构成和贸易开放度在自动化响应机制中的调节作用；3. 强调了宏观一致性自动化衡量方法相对于技术特定代理变量的理论优势。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为企业自动化决策提供实证依据：劳动力成本上升、兼职员工比例增加时应考虑加快自动化；2. 为政策制定者提供参考：贸易政策可能通过影响自动化进程而改变劳动力市场结构；3. 为行业分析提供新工具：宏观一致性自动化指标能更准确地评估行业自动化趋势。

title: Private Enforcement of Competition Law in Latvia
affiliations: Riga Graduate School of Law

detail.title: Private Enforcement of Competition Law in Latvia
detail.abstract:
This chapter provides an empirically grounded analysis of private competition enforcement in Latvia, drawing on a comprehensive review of case law from the Economic Court, the Riga Regional Court, and the Supreme Court Senate.

The publication addresses the full scope of the Latvian private enforcement framework — from the pre-Damages Directive legislative landscape and the 2017 transposition of the EU Damages Directive. Key topics include Latvia's distinctive 10% cartel overcharge presumption, the practical use (and limited uptake) of disclosure mechanisms, the probatory value of decisions by the Latvian Competition Council, and judicial approaches to the quantification of damages.

AI.tldr: 本文基于拉脱维亚经济法院、里加地区法院和最高法院的案例法，对拉脱维亚私人竞争执法进行了实证分析，涵盖损害赔偿指令实施前后的法律框架、10%卡特尔超额收费推定、证据披露机制使用、竞争委员会决定的证据价值以及损害赔偿量化方法等关键议题。
AI.research_question: 拉脱维亚私人竞争执法框架的实际运作效果如何？特别是在欧盟损害赔偿指令实施后，拉脱维亚独特的10%卡特尔超额收费推定、证据披露机制、竞争委员会决定的证据价值以及损害赔偿量化方法在实践中如何应用？
AI.motivation: 欧盟损害赔偿指令要求成员国建立有效的私人竞争执法机制，但各国实施情况存在差异。拉脱维亚作为欧盟成员国，其独特的10%卡特尔超额收费推定和其他制度设计需要实证研究来评估实际效果，为政策制定者和法律实践者提供参考。
AI.theoretical_framework: 竞争法私人执行理论、欧盟损害赔偿指令的法律移植理论、证据法理论（特别是推定规则和证据披露机制）、损害赔偿量化理论。
AI.method: 实证案例分析法，对拉脱维亚经济法院、里加地区法院和最高法院的判例进行全面审查，分析私人竞争执法案件的法律实践。
AI.findings: 1. 拉脱维亚独特的10%卡特尔超额收费推定在实践中得到应用；2. 证据披露机制使用有限；3. 竞争委员会的决定在诉讼中具有重要证据价值；4. 法院在损害赔偿量化方面形成了特定的司法方法；5. 欧盟损害赔偿指令的实施改变了拉脱维亚的私人执法框架。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 丰富了欧盟损害赔偿指令在不同成员国实施效果的比较研究；2. 为推定规则在竞争法私人执行中的应用提供了实证证据；3. 揭示了法律移植过程中本土制度与欧盟规则的互动关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为拉脱维亚竞争法律师和法官提供实践指导；2. 为政策制定者评估现行制度效果提供依据；3. 为其他欧盟成员国提供比较法参考；4. 帮助企业了解在拉脱维亚提起竞争损害赔偿诉讼的实际可能性。

title: Green Game in Town: Intra-Industry Spillover Effects of Corporate Green Bond Announcements in the US
affiliations: ,  and Florida International University (FIU)

detail.title: Green Game in Town: Intra-Industry Spillover Effects of Corporate Green Bond Announcements in the US
detail.abstract: We investigate whether announcements of green bond issuance by firms have any effect on the value of their rivals. Using data on green bond announcements by US firms over the period 2013-2023, we find that a positive (negative) stock price reaction to green bond announcements by firms is associated with a positive (negative) stock price reaction for their industry rivals. Specifically, a one-percentage-point change in the event firm's announcement-period abnormal return is accompanied by a 38-basis-point change in the closest rival's abnormal return in the same direction. Our results suggest the presence of intra-industry information spillovers in response to green bond announcements, whereby the market interprets the issuance as industry-wide information rather than just issuerspecific news. Notably, the observed effect is stronger when the announcement involves a first-time issue, a relatively large offering size, and an issue by an industry leader, consistent with the notion that these events carry greater information content for the industry. Our results remain robust to alternative explanations and a battery of checks.

AI.tldr: 研究发现企业发行绿色债券的公告对其竞争对手的股价有显著影响，存在行业内信息溢出效应，市场将绿色债券发行视为行业整体信息而非仅发行人特定消息。
AI.research_question: 企业宣布发行绿色债券是否会影响其竞争对手的价值？
AI.motivation: 随着绿色债券市场的快速发展，需要了解绿色金融工具如何影响行业内企业间的竞争动态和信息传递。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信息溢出理论，市场将企业特定事件（如绿色债券发行）解读为包含行业整体信息，从而影响竞争对手的估值。
AI.method: 使用2013-2023年美国企业绿色债券公告数据，采用事件研究法分析公告期异常回报，并检验竞争对手股价反应。
AI.findings: 绿色债券公告对发行企业股价的正向（负向）反应伴随着竞争对手股价同方向的38个基点的变化；首次发行、较大发行规模、行业领导者发行时效应更强。
AI.theory_contributions: 证实了绿色债券公告存在行业内信息溢出效应，拓展了企业金融和环境金融交叉领域的研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供了绿色债券公告对行业内其他企业影响的量化证据，帮助企业理解绿色金融决策的行业影响。

title: Determinants of Job Stress: A Longitudinal Study of Japanese Employees
affiliations: Iwate University and Kyushu University

detail.title: Determinants of Job Stress: A Longitudinal Study of Japanese Employees
detail.abstract:
Objectives: The World Health Organization states that mental illness will become the leading burden of disease globally, by 2030. Thus, examinations of job-stress might require more heterogeneous and innovative solutions. This study aims to confirm causality of the effect of the work environment and employees’ responses on improving their psychological well-being, in Japan.

Methods: We used data from over 1 million questionnaires collected from 390 companies for a large scale 3-year longitudinal study (N = 1,021,178), from 2017 to 2019. The lagged variable method was used to investigate the casual effect.

Results: We found that psychological stress-related health conditions have been continuously worsening among employees’ of Japanese companies. Considering both the work environment and employees’ responses, is crucial for improving the psychological health of employees. Positive thinking had the most positive impact on employees’ job stress status among the determinant factors. Work environment stressors that negatively impacted job stress included high job demand, low decision latitude, low social support, high psychological demand, effort–reward imbalance, high work load, job insecurity, work-life imbalance, and harassment.

Conclusions: Employees’ responses associated change in mood, positive thinking, and talking to people they trust, with a positive influence on reducing stress. Further, thinking positively, not taking the problem too seriously, and avoiding directing feelings of anger and frustration toward others, reduced high-stress in 49% of respondent employees. Among these characteristics, we found that positive thinking has the greatest impact on employees’ psychological well-being.

AI.tldr: 这项研究通过大规模纵向数据分析，确认了工作环境和员工应对方式对心理健康的因果影响。研究发现日本员工的心理压力状况持续恶化，积极思维对缓解工作压力有最显著的正向影响，而高工作需求、低决策自主权等工作环境因素则产生负面影响。
AI.research_question: 工作环境和员工应对方式如何影响日本员工的心理学福祉？这些因素之间是否存在因果关系？
AI.motivation: 世界卫生组织预测到2030年心理疾病将成为全球主要疾病负担，需要更异质化和创新的解决方案来应对工作压力问题。日本作为工作压力较大的国家，需要实证研究来确认工作环境和员工应对方式对心理健康的因果影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于工作压力理论，包括工作要求-控制模型、努力-回报失衡理论、工作-生活平衡理论等。研究考察了工作环境压力源（如工作要求、决策自主权、社会支持等）和员工应对策略（如积极思维、情绪调节等）对心理健康的影响。
AI.method: 使用2017-2019年390家公司超过102万份问卷的大规模3年纵向数据。采用滞后变量法来检验因果关系，确保时间顺序上的因果推断。
AI.findings: 1. 日本员工的心理压力相关健康状况持续恶化；2. 积极思维对员工工作压力状态有最积极的影响；3. 负面工作环境因素包括：高工作要求、低决策自主权、低社会支持、高心理需求、努力-回报失衡、高工作负荷、工作不安全感、工作-生活失衡和骚扰；4. 员工应对方式如情绪变化、积极思维和与信任的人交谈对减轻压力有积极影响；5. 积极思维、不过分认真对待问题、避免将愤怒和挫败感指向他人，可使49%的高压力员工压力降低。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 通过大规模纵向数据验证了工作压力理论的因果机制；2. 明确了积极思维作为最有效的压力应对策略的理论重要性；3. 为工作环境-员工应对交互作用模型提供了实证支持；4. 在日本文化背景下验证了西方工作压力理论的适用性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为企业提供了改善员工心理健康的具体干预方向：既要改善工作环境，也要培养员工积极应对策略；2. 识别了最有效的员工应对策略（积极思维），可用于设计心理健康培训项目；3. 为政策制定者提供了基于证据的工作压力管理建议；4. 帮助企业识别高风险工作环境因素，进行针对性改善。

title: The Space Economy's Dual Face: How Exploration Creates a Sustainability Trap and Intergenerational Moral Hazard
affiliations: Universitas Mercatorum and Ministero dell’Istruzione, dell’Università e della Ricerca Italiana

detail.title: The Space Economy's Dual Face: How Exploration Creates a Sustainability Trap and Intergenerational Moral Hazard
detail.abstract: Space activities are dualistic: sustainability-oriented missions enhance terrestrial resource management, while exploration missions generate environmental costs and weaken conservation incentives. This paper develops a dynamic stochastic model with an ecological tipping point and delayed uncertain extraterrestrial discoveries. Present generations bear the costs of exploration, while future generations benefit only if projects succeed. We identify three mechanisms that are at work: exploration-induced overextraction, intergenerational moral hazard, and a sustainability trap. Extending to a multi-country setting with first-mover advantages exclusive benefits for the first successful nation, we show that non-cooperative behavior leads to underinvestment in sustainability and overextraction. Simulations calibrated to China, United States and the European Union, quantify welfare losses from non-cooperation and show that first-mover incentives exacerbate resource depletion. Our results highlight unintended spatial missions' feedbacks and underscore the need for international coordination.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个包含生态临界点和延迟不确定外星发现的动态随机模型，分析太空活动的双重性：可持续性任务改善地球资源管理，而探索任务产生环境成本并削弱保护动机。研究发现探索导致过度开采、代际道德风险和可持续性陷阱三种机制。在多国博弈中，先发优势导致非合作行为造成可持续性投资不足和过度开采。模拟量化了非合作带来的福利损失。
AI.research_question: 太空活动如何通过探索诱导的过度开采、代际道德风险和可持续性陷阱等机制影响地球资源管理和生态可持续性？在多国博弈中，先发优势如何影响国际合作与资源开采决策？
AI.motivation: 太空活动具有双重性：可持续性任务（如地球观测）有助于改善地球资源管理，而探索任务（如外星资源开发）会产生环境成本并削弱地球保护动机。当前缺乏对太空活动如何通过复杂机制影响地球生态系统的系统性分析，特别是考虑代际公平和国际竞争的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态随机模型，包含生态临界点和延迟不确定的外星发现；代际经济学理论；博弈论框架下的多国竞争模型；先发优势理论；资源经济学中的开采决策理论。
AI.method: 构建包含生态临界点和延迟不确定外星发现的动态随机模型；扩展到多国博弈框架，考虑先发优势；使用中国、美国和欧盟数据进行校准模拟；量化非合作行为导致的福利损失。
AI.findings: 识别出三种关键机制：探索诱导的过度开采、代际道德风险和可持续性陷阱；多国非合作行为导致可持续性投资不足和资源过度开采；先发优势加剧资源耗竭；模拟显示非合作造成显著的福利损失。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将太空活动双重性纳入生态经济模型；提出探索诱导过度开采、代际道德风险和可持续性陷阱三个新机制；扩展了包含生态临界点和延迟不确定性的动态随机模型；发展了考虑先发优势的多国太空竞争理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 量化了非合作太空竞赛的福利损失；为国际太空政策协调提供理论依据；揭示了先发优势对资源可持续性的负面影响；为中国、美国和欧盟的太空政策制定提供参考；强调了国际协调在太空活动中的必要性。

title: Economics in the Post-AI Era
affiliations: and GoldennanoX Research Institute, Singapore

detail.title: Economics in the Post-AI Era
detail.abstract:
This paper proposes a “four-ring constraint model for the post-AI era” to explain why the traditional industrial-age cycle of “labor–wages–consumption–reproduction” is loosening, and even partially breaking, as artificial intelligence increasingly en-
ters the domains of production, services, decision-making, and management. It argues that the central contradiction of the post-AI era is no longer merely how to raise labor productivity under conditions of scarcity, but whether society can convert AI-driven expansion in productive capacity into broad-based income through effective distribution, whether institutional arrangements can sustain effective demand, whether governance adaptation can absorb technological shocks, and whether sovereign capacity can prevent key value chains from being persistently constrained by external systems.
     To characterize this structural transformation, the paper constructs a macro- framework composed of four positive links and three negative constraints. Productive capacity, distributive capacity, demand capacity, and social stability capacity jointly determine effective social output; meanwhile, ecological entropy costs, governance lag costs, and the costs of global rivalry and compute sovereignty continuously erode effective output. While preserving the model’s intuitive formulation, the pa-
per further proposes a normalized specification to address the issues of multiplicative structure and dimensional consistency; it also endogenizes governance lag to show how the speed of institutional response suppresses the release of technological
dividends. In addition, it discusses the fiscal feasibility of distributive institutions, the expansion of demand from material consumption to meaning-oriented demand, and the balance between compute sovereignty and system openness.
     The core conclusion is that the most successful economies of the future will not necessarily be those with the strongest AI capabilities, but rather those that, on the basis of high productive capacity, can simultaneously establish effective distribution,
sustainable demand, institutional buffering, and sovereign capacity, while keeping ecological, governance, and external dependency costs within bearable limits. In this sense, the central issue of the post-AI era is not merely how to make AI stronger, but how to strengthen institutions, distributive arrangements, and mechanisms of social stability in tandem with AI. Economic prosperity in the post-AI era will no longer be merely the outcome of an expanded production function; it will be the outcome of a new equilibrium among production, distribution, demand, and stability under new technological conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"后AI时代的四环约束模型"，解释传统工业时代"劳动-工资-消费-再生产"循环为何在AI时代松动断裂，认为后AI时代核心矛盾不再是稀缺条件下的劳动生产率提升，而是如何将AI驱动的生产能力扩张转化为广泛收入分配、维持有效需求、吸收技术冲击、保障关键价值链主权。成功经济体将是那些在高效生产能力基础上，同时建立有效分配、可持续需求、制度缓冲和主权能力，并将生态、治理和外部依赖成本控制在可承受范围内的国家。
AI.research_question: 为什么传统工业时代的"劳动-工资-消费-再生产"循环在后AI时代会松动甚至断裂？后AI时代经济繁荣的关键决定因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 随着人工智能日益进入生产、服务、决策和管理领域，传统工业时代的经济循环模式正在发生根本性变化。需要新的理论框架来解释这一结构性转型，并指导后AI时代的经济政策制定。
AI.theoretical_framework: 四环约束模型：由生产能力、分配能力、需求能力、社会稳定能力四个正向环节构成，同时受到生态熵成本、治理滞后成本、全球竞争与算力主权成本三个负向约束。模型强调生产、分配、需求、稳定之间的新均衡。
AI.method: 构建宏观理论框架，包括四个正向联系和三个负向约束的模型化表达。提出标准化规范以解决乘数结构和维度一致性问题，将治理滞后内生化，分析制度响应速度对技术红利释放的抑制作用。
AI.findings: 未来最成功的经济体不一定是AI能力最强的，而是在高生产能力基础上，能同时建立有效分配、可持续需求、制度缓冲和主权能力，并将生态、治理和外部依赖成本控制在可承受范围内的经济体。后AI时代经济繁荣是生产、分配、需求、稳定在新技术条件下的新均衡结果。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出后AI时代四环约束模型，解释传统经济循环的断裂机制；2) 将治理滞后内生化，分析制度响应速度对技术红利的影响；3) 建立生产能力、分配能力、需求能力、社会稳定能力的综合框架；4) 强调生态、治理、主权成本对有效产出的侵蚀作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为政策制定者提供后AI时代经济治理的框架性指导；2) 强调分配制度、需求扩张、制度适应和主权保障的协同重要性；3) 指出财政可行性、意义导向需求、算力主权与系统开放平衡等具体政策议题；4) 帮助识别未来经济成功的关键决定因素。

reference: 19 NYU Journal of Law & Liberty 245 (2026).
title: October 7 on Trial

detail.title: October 7 on Trial

publicationDetails.detailsText: 19 NYU Journal of Law & Liberty 245 (2026).

detail.abstract: The 2023 October 7 attack marked the deadliest day in Israel's history and triggered an urgent legal reckoning: How should the perpetrators of such atrocities be prosecuted, and under what framework? This Article addresses the complex challenge of prosecuting non-state actors engaged in asymmetric warfare, while ensuring credibility, fairness, and global legitimacy. It analyzes competing proposals over venue (domestic versus international), forum (civilian, military, or ad hoc), and applicable law (national, military, or international criminal law), situating the debate within broader struggles over post-conflict justice. Drawing on comparative experiences across international, hybrid, and domestic prosecutions of mass atrocities-from Nuremberg to the ICTY to Israel's own Eichmann trialthe Article distills cross-jurisdictional lessons about procedural integrity, institutional legitimacy, and the symbolic power of law in moments of rupture. It cautions against the dangers of politicized justice and "show trials," proposing a novel accountability framework designed to withstand both political volatility and legitimacy crises. In doing so, it positions the legal response to October 7 as a universally relevant test case with enduring relevance for the global fight against terrorism, one that may shape how democracies confront mass violence without compromising justice and the rule of law.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨如何起诉2023年10月7日袭击的非国家行为者，分析不同起诉框架（国内/国际、民事/军事/特设法庭、适用法律），提出能抵御政治化和合法性危机的新型问责框架。
AI.research_question: 在不对称战争中，如何以可信、公平且具有全球合法性的方式起诉非国家行为者的大规模暴行？
AI.motivation: 2023年10月7日袭击是以色列历史上最致命的一天，引发了紧急的法律清算需求，需要解决如何起诉此类暴行以及适用何种法律框架的问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 冲突后司法理论、国际刑事法理论、比较司法制度理论、法律象征主义理论、程序完整性理论、制度合法性理论。
AI.method: 比较分析法：分析从纽伦堡审判、前南斯拉夫问题国际刑事法庭到以色列艾希曼审判等国际、混合和国内大规模暴行起诉案例，提炼跨司法管辖区的经验教训。
AI.findings: 不同起诉框架各有优缺点，政治化司法和"作秀审判"存在危险，需要平衡程序完整性、制度合法性和法律在断裂时刻的象征力量。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个能抵御政治波动和合法性危机的新型问责框架，深化了冲突后司法理论，为法律在不对称战争中的角色提供了理论洞见。
AI.practical_contributions: 为处理10月7日袭击的法律应对提供了具体框架建议，为民主国家在不损害司法和法治原则的前提下应对大规模暴力提供了实践指导，具有全球反恐斗争的普遍参考价值。

title: Who Captures Incentives for Small Firms? Size-based Tax and Profit Shifting
affiliations: Zhejiang University - College of Economics, Zhejiang University and Zhejiang University

detail.title: Who Captures Incentives for Small Firms? Size-based Tax and Profit Shifting
detail.abstract: Large companies related to small and medium enterprises (SMEs) can exploit size-based tax incentives by profit shifting, effectively using SMEs as "tax havens" within groups. When such tax-motivated profit shifting occurs, increases in reported SME profits do not reflect real economic changes, rendering the elasticity of taxable income (ETI) potentially misleading. Leveraging upward adjustments to notch-based corporate tax thresholds in China, this paper identifies size-based profit shifting. We find that affiliated SMEs exhibit substantially higher ETI estimates than unaffiliated SMEs, while linked large firms report significantly lower taxable income. Quantitatively, profit shifting explains 43% to 68% of profit increases of affiliated SMEs and 30% to 39% of the aggregate growth of SME profits, which accounts well for the ETI gap between affiliated and non-affiliated SMEs. Finally, a sufficient-statistics welfare analysis reveals that accounting for profit shifting reduces the estimated aggregate welfare gains of size-based tax incentives by 50%-85%.

AI.tldr: 大型企业利用中小企业享受的规模税收优惠进行利润转移，将中小企业作为集团内的"税收避风港"，导致应税收入弹性(ETI)估计失真。研究发现关联中小企业的ETI估计值远高于非关联中小企业，而关联大企业应税收入显著降低。利润转移解释了43%-68%的关联中小企业利润增长和30%-39%的中小企业总利润增长，并解释了ETI差距。考虑利润转移后，规模税收优惠的福利收益估计减少50%-85%。
AI.research_question: 大型企业如何利用中小企业的规模税收优惠进行利润转移？这种利润转移对弹性应税收入(ETI)估计有何影响？利润转移在多大程度上解释了关联中小企业与非关联中小企业之间的ETI差距？考虑利润转移后，规模税收优惠的福利效应如何变化？
AI.motivation: 中小企业通常享受基于规模的税收优惠政策，但大型企业可能通过集团内部的利润转移来利用这些优惠，将中小企业作为"税收避风港"。这种税收动机的利润转移可能导致报告的利润变化不反映真实经济变化，使ETI估计产生偏差，进而影响对税收政策效果的评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 利润转移理论：企业通过内部交易将利润从高税率实体转移到低税率实体；2. 弹性应税收入(ETI)理论：衡量税收变化对应税收入的影响；3. 税收套利理论：企业利用不同税收制度差异获取税收利益；4. 福利经济学：评估税收政策的社会福利效应。
AI.method: 利用中国基于门槛的法人税起征点上调作为准自然实验，识别基于规模的利润转移。比较关联中小企业与非关联中小企业的ETI估计差异，分析关联大企业的应税收入变化。采用定量方法估计利润转移对中小企业利润增长的贡献度，并进行充分统计量的福利分析。
AI.findings: 1. 关联中小企业的ETI估计值显著高于非关联中小企业；2. 关联大企业报告了显著更低的应税收入；3. 利润转移解释了43%-68%的关联中小企业利润增长；4. 利润转移解释了30%-39%的中小企业总利润增长；5. 利润转移很好地解释了关联与非关联中小企业之间的ETI差距；6. 考虑利润转移后，规模税收优惠的福利收益估计减少50%-85%。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了大型企业利用中小企业税收优惠进行利润转移的新机制；2. 证明了利润转移如何导致ETI估计失真，为ETI文献提供了重要补充；3. 提供了基于规模税收优惠的利润转移实证证据；4. 发展了考虑利润转移的税收政策福利评估框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了关于规模税收优惠被滥用的实证证据；2. 揭示了现行税收政策可能产生的意外后果；3. 提供了评估税收政策真实效果的方法论工具；4. 为税收征管部门识别和防范利润转移提供了参考依据；5. 有助于设计更有效的税收优惠政策。

title: Riemannian Geometry of the Moment Manifold in Relativistic Kinetic Theory and the Approach to Hydrodynamics
affiliations: University of Exeter

detail.title: Riemannian Geometry of the Moment Manifold in Relativistic Kinetic Theory and the Approach to Hydrodynamics
detail.abstract: Working within the relaxation-time approximation (RTA) of the Boltzmann equation and the conformal DNMR 14-moment truncation for Bjorken flow, we construct a Fisher-Rao metric on the associated finite-dimensional moment manifold and study its Riemannian geometry. All core results are derived in this specific setting; extensions to other collision kernels, non-conformal gases, and multi-channel transport are discussed as conjectural generalisations or numerical illustrations. The equilibrium dissipative metric is the constant gαα|eq = 2/15, which determines the shear viscosity as η = 4P τR/5. The full geodesic Fisher-Rao distance differs from the linearised approximation by 15-35% at moderate shear. The five-dimensional conformal shear sector at equilibrium has Ricci scalar R|eq =-5/21, whereas any one-dimensional Bjorken restriction is flat. The ten sectional curvatures have mixed sign and define a hierarchy of geodesic deviation rates through the Jacobi equation. Because the equilibrium metric and Amari-Chentsov tensor depend only on the angular distribution of the moment function on S 2 , this hierarchy is independent of the collision kernel within the DNMR truncation; whether it has dynamical consequences for hydrodynamisation rates is an open question. For a massive classical gas (not QCD), the dissipative metric acquires temperature dependence and the two-dimensional (T, απ) curvature peaks near T ∼ m. Israel-Stewart trajectories have O(1) geodesic curvature throughout, showing the hydrodynamic attractor is dynamical rather than geometric.

AI.tldr: 该论文在弛豫时间近似和DNMR 14矩截断下，为Bjorken流构建了有限维矩流形上的Fisher-Rao度量，并研究其黎曼几何性质。核心发现包括：平衡态耗散度量为常数，全测地距离与线性近似有显著差异，曲率具有混合符号，以及Israel-Stewart轨迹具有O(1)测地曲率。
AI.research_question: 如何在弛豫时间近似和DNMR 14矩截断框架下，为Bjorken流构建Fisher-Rao度量并研究其黎曼几何性质？这些几何特性对流体化过程有何物理意义？
AI.motivation: 研究流体动力学吸引子的几何结构，探索耗散输运过程的几何描述，理解流体化速率与曲率之间的关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 弛豫时间近似下的Boltzmann方程，DNMR 14矩截断，Bjorken流，Fisher-Rao信息几何，黎曼几何，矩流形理论。
AI.method: 在弛豫时间近似和DNMR 14矩截断的特定设置下，为Bjorken流构建有限维矩流形上的Fisher-Rao度量，分析其黎曼几何性质（度量、曲率、测地线等），并进行数值计算验证。
AI.findings: 1. 平衡态耗散度量为常数gαα|eq = 2/15，由此确定剪切粘度为η = 4P τR/5；2. 全测地Fisher-Rao距离与线性近似在中等剪切下相差15-35%；3. 平衡态五维共形剪切扇区Ricci标量为R|eq =-5/21，而一维Bjorken限制是平坦的；4. 十个截面曲率具有混合符号，定义了通过Jacobi方程的测地偏离率层次结构；5. Israel-Stewart轨迹具有O(1)测地曲率，表明流体动力学吸引子是动力学的而非几何的。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次在弛豫时间近似和DNMR截断下为Bjorken流构建了Fisher-Rao度量；2. 建立了耗散输运过程的信息几何描述框架；3. 揭示了矩流形的曲率结构与流体化速率之间的潜在联系；4. 证明了Israel-Stewart吸引子的动力学本质。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为理解重离子碰撞中的流体化过程提供了新的几何视角；2. 曲率分析有助于识别流体动力学描述的有效性边界；3. 为数值模拟中的矩截断方法提供了几何解释；4. 为研究非平衡统计力学中的信息几何应用开辟了新途径。

title: Impact of Universal Primary Education on Intergenerational Persistence in Education; Evidence from Kenya
affiliations: and Tokai University

detail.title: Impact of Universal Primary Education on Intergenerational Persistence in Education; Evidence from Kenya
detail.abstract:
In this paper, we empirically investigate the effect of parental years of schooling on children’s educational investment using household survey data from Kenya. A positive correlation between parents’ and children’s years of schooling implies that the accumulation of children’s human capital is influenced by the household into which they are born, suggesting that educational inequality is transmitted across generations and may become entrenched over time. In this context, it is important to examine the role of government support, particularly the Free Primary Education (FPE) policy, in mitigating such intergenerational transmission.

The originality of this study lies in its ability to distinguish between children who benefited from the FPE policy and those who did not, and to analyze both groups using an instrumental variables approach to identify causal effects. In general, parental schooling may positively affect children’s educational investment through multiple channels. For example, an increase in parental schooling is likely to raise parents’ earnings, thereby easing budget constraints and facilitating greater investment in their children’s education.

The results show that the effect of parental schooling on children’s educational investment was more pronounced prior to the introduction of the FPE policy, whereas the effect became smaller after the policy was implemented. These findings suggest that the FPE policy weakened the influence of parental schooling and played a certain role in reducing the intergenerational transmission of educational inequality.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用肯尼亚家庭调查数据，实证检验了父母受教育年限对子女教育投资的影响，并特别考察了免费初等教育政策在缓解教育不平等代际传递中的作用。
AI.research_question: 父母受教育年限如何影响子女的教育投资？免费初等教育政策是否能够缓解教育不平等的代际传递？
AI.motivation: 父母与子女受教育年限的正相关关系表明，儿童人力资本积累受到出生家庭的影响，教育不平等可能在代际间传递并固化。在此背景下，研究政府支持（特别是免费初等教育政策）在缓解这种代际传递中的作用具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人力资本理论、代际传递理论、教育投资决策理论。父母教育通过多种渠道影响子女教育投资，如提高父母收入缓解预算约束等。
AI.method: 使用肯尼亚家庭调查数据，采用工具变量法识别因果效应。研究创新性地区分了受益于免费初等教育政策与未受益的儿童群体。
AI.findings: 父母教育对子女教育投资的影响在免费初等教育政策实施前更为显著，政策实施后该影响变小。这表明免费初等教育政策削弱了父母教育的影响，在减少教育不平等代际传递方面发挥了一定作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 为教育不平等代际传递机制提供了实证证据，验证了政府教育政策在缓解代际传递中的调节作用，丰富了人力资本代际传递的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为肯尼亚及其他发展中国家制定教育政策提供依据，证明免费初等教育政策能够有效缓解家庭背景对教育机会的影响，为促进教育公平提供政策参考。

title: Computational Limits on Rational Expectations: Production Networks and the Boundaries of the Lucas Critique

detail.title: Computational Limits on Rational Expectations: Production Networks and the Boundaries of the Lucas Critique
detail.abstract: The Lucas critique presumes that agents can compute the equilibrium mapping from policy rules to prices. This paper shows that in production network economies with discrete supplier choices, computing rational expectations equilibrium is NP-hard. The combinatorial structure arises endogenously from firms' sourcing decisions: each firm chooses among discrete suppliers, equilibrium prices depend on the realized network configuration, and the number of possible configurations grows exponentially with the number of firms. Because this intractability is structural rather than frictional, it cannot be resolved through improved information or reduced transaction costs. Policy interventions that shift network configurations may therefore have persistent effects that do not vanish as agents learn the economic environment. These results circumscribe the domain of the Lucas critique: policy irrelevance holds when equilibria are computationally accessible, but fails when the equilibrium mapping lies beyond feasible computation.

AI.tldr: 该论文证明，在生产网络经济中，当企业面临离散供应商选择时，计算理性预期均衡是NP难问题。这种组合复杂性源于企业的采购决策，导致政策干预可能产生持久影响，从而限制了卢卡斯批判的适用范围。
AI.research_question: 在具有离散供应商选择的生产网络经济中，计算理性预期均衡的计算复杂性如何影响卢卡斯批判的有效性？
AI.motivation: 卢卡斯批判假设经济主体能够计算从政策规则到价格的均衡映射，但在现实经济中，企业面临离散的供应商选择，形成复杂的生产网络结构，这可能使得均衡计算变得不可行。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生产网络理论、理性预期均衡、计算复杂性理论（NP-hard问题）、卢卡斯批判、离散选择模型
AI.method: 理论建模方法，构建具有离散供应商选择的生产网络经济模型，运用计算复杂性理论分析均衡计算问题，通过数学证明展示NP-hard性质。
AI.findings: 1. 在生产网络经济中，当企业面临离散供应商选择时，计算理性预期均衡是NP-hard问题；2. 这种计算复杂性是结构性的而非摩擦性的，无法通过改善信息或降低交易成本解决；3. 政策干预可能产生持久影响，不会随着经济主体学习而消失；4. 卢卡斯批判仅在均衡可计算时成立，当均衡映射超出可行计算范围时失效。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将计算复杂性理论引入宏观经济学分析；2. 揭示了生产网络结构中离散选择导致的内生组合复杂性；3. 为卢卡斯批判的有效性设定了计算边界；4. 提出了结构性不可计算性的概念，区别于传统的信息摩擦。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了理解政策干预持久影响的新视角；2. 解释了为什么某些政策效果可能长期存在；3. 强调了在设计经济政策时需要考虑均衡计算可行性的重要性；4. 为评估政策有效性提供了新的理论框架。

title: The COVID-19 Pandemic and Interpersonal Comparison: Evidence from Individuals with Suicidal Ideation and Previous Suicide Attempts in Japan
affiliations: and Toyo University

detail.title: The COVID-19 Pandemic and Interpersonal Comparison: Evidence from Individuals with Suicidal Ideation and Previous Suicide Attempts in Japan
detail.abstract:
The COVID-19 pandemic and associated preventive measures substantially disrupted working conditions and were widely expected to worsen mental health. However, in Japan, the monthly suicide mortality rate did not significantly increase from January to June 2020 compared with the same month of the five-year average. In fact, the suicide rate among men significantly decreased, which creates behavioral puzzle. This study examines whether individuals with suicidal ideation or prior suicide attempts experienced improvements in mental health during this period and explores the role of interpersonal comparison.

 

Using a panel dataset, we performed a fixed-effects estimation and found that individuals with suicidal ideation had a lower level of psychological stress in early 2020 compared with 2019. We further show that variation in local labor-market conditions shaped this response: declines in prefecture-level average working hours were associated with larger reductions in distress among individuals with suicidal ideation compared with those without.

 

These findings are consistent with an interpersonal comparison mechanism in which individuals with suicidal ideation experienced relative psychological relief when they witnessed others facing severe changes in their work environments during the early stages of the COVID-19 pandemic. The results provide behavioral evidence that relative social position and comparison processes can mitigate distress among vulnerable individuals during macroeconomic shocks.

AI.tldr: 日本在COVID-19初期自杀率未上升反而下降，研究发现有自杀意念者因看到他人工作环境恶化而获得相对心理缓解
AI.research_question: 有自杀意念或既往自杀尝试者在疫情期间心理健康是否改善？人际比较在其中起什么作用？
AI.motivation: 日本在2020年1-6月自杀死亡率未显著上升，男性自杀率反而显著下降，形成行为谜题，需要解释这一反常现象
AI.theoretical_framework: 人际比较理论（社会比较理论），相对社会地位对心理健康的影响
AI.method: 使用面板数据集进行固定效应估计，分析地方劳动力市场条件变化的影响
AI.findings: 有自杀意念者在2020年初心理压力低于2019年；地区平均工作时间下降与有自杀意念者心理困扰减少相关
AI.theory_contributions: 提供行为证据表明相对社会地位和比较过程可以在宏观经济冲击期间缓解弱势个体的心理困扰
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了疫情期间心理健康变化的复杂机制，为制定针对弱势群体的心理健康干预措施提供新视角

title: The Independence of the Federal Reserve and the Impact of Overturning Humphrey's Executor v. United States (1935): Be Careful What You Wish For

detail.title: The Independence of the Federal Reserve and the Impact of Overturning Humphrey's Executor v. United States (1935): Be Careful What You Wish For
detail.abstract: Calls to overturn Humphrey's Executor v. United States have intensified among advocates of unitary executive theory. Yet a sweeping decision could unintentionally destabilize the institution whose insulation from politics sustains American monetary credibility-the Federal Reserve. This essay argues that the Fed occupies a distinct constitutional position: it executes Congress's Article I power to "coin Money [and] regulate the Value thereof," not the President's Article II enforcement authority. Empirical research confirms that central bank independence correlates with lower inflation and more stable growth, while American history-from 1970s stagflation to the Volcker disinflation-demonstrates the costs of political control over monetary policy. If the Court removes statutory protections for independent agencies, it should carve out a constitutional distinction for the Federal Reserve as the nation's monetary authority. Reformers should be careful what they wish for. *This paper is under consideration at the George Mason Law Review

AI.tldr: 本文认为，尽管单一行政理论支持者呼吁推翻Humphrey's Executor案，但全面推翻该案可能破坏美联储的政治独立性，而这是美国货币信用的基础。文章主张美联储具有独特的宪法地位，执行国会的第一条权力而非总统的第二条执行权，应获得宪法层面的特殊保护。
AI.research_question: 在单一行政理论挑战独立机构宪法地位的背景下，美联储是否应获得特殊的宪法保护以维持其政治独立性？
AI.motivation: 单一行政理论支持者日益呼吁推翻Humphrey's Executor案，这可能威胁到独立机构的法定保护，特别是美联储的政治独立性，而历史经验表明政治干预货币政策会导致严重后果（如1970年代滞胀）。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1) 单一行政理论；2) 宪法分权理论（第一条国会权力 vs 第二条总统权力）；3) 中央银行独立性理论；4) 制度稳定性理论
AI.method: 1) 宪法文本分析（第一条与第二条权力区分）；2) 实证研究综述（央行独立性与经济表现的关系）；3) 历史案例分析（1970年代滞胀与沃尔克反通胀时期）
AI.findings: 1) 美联储执行的是国会第一条"铸造货币、调节币值"的权力，而非总统第二条执行权；2) 央行独立性与较低通胀、更稳定增长相关；3) 美国历史显示政治控制货币政策成本高昂；4) 美联储应获得宪法层面的特殊保护
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出美联储的独特宪法地位理论；2) 为央行独立性提供宪法理论基础；3) 挑战单一行政理论的普遍适用性；4) 建立货币政策机构与宪法结构的理论联系
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为最高法院提供具体司法建议：若推翻独立机构保护，应为美联储设立宪法例外；2) 警告改革者全面推翻Humphrey's Executor案的风险；3) 为货币政策制定者提供制度保护依据；4) 维护美国货币信用和金融稳定

title: Administrative Substitution and the Constitution: Restoring Decision-Making at the Margin

detail.title: Administrative Substitution and the Constitution: Restoring Decision-Making at the Margin
detail.abstract: The Constitution regulates who may exercise power and through what procedures, but it is largely silent on where government may intervene within ordinary decision processes. That silence has permitted systematic administrative substitution-the displacement of decentralized, consequence-bearing private choice with centralized administrative judgment. Unlike traditional regulation, which constrains conduct while preserving choice, administrative substitution replaces choice itself: administered prices for market discovery, licensing for entry, guarantees for risk-bearing, institutional assignment for family authority. The result is margin suppression-the elimination of decision points through which societies generate information, discipline error, and adapt to change. Using public education as a case study, this Article demonstrates how administrative substitution has displaced families from meaningful authority over their children's schooling. Recent decisions rejecting Chevron deference restore judicial responsibility for statutory interpretation but do not address this structural problem. The Article concludes by proposing a constitutional amendment to restore decision-making margins while preserving regulation necessary to prevent direct and material harm.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨宪法对政府干预普通决策过程的沉默如何导致系统性行政替代——用集中行政判断取代分散的、承担后果的私人选择。与传统规制不同，行政替代直接取代选择本身，导致边际抑制，消除社会产生信息、纠正错误和适应变化的决策点。以公共教育为例，文章展示了行政替代如何剥夺家庭对子女教育的实质性权威。文章最后提出宪法修正案建议，以恢复决策边际，同时保留防止直接和实质性伤害的必要规制。
AI.research_question: 宪法对政府干预普通决策过程的沉默如何导致系统性行政替代，以及如何通过宪法修正案恢复决策边际同时保留必要规制？
AI.motivation: 宪法规定了权力行使者和程序，但对政府可在普通决策过程中干预的范围保持沉默。这种沉默允许了系统性行政替代——用集中行政判断取代分散的、承担后果的私人选择，导致边际抑制，消除社会产生信息、纠正错误和适应变化的决策点。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 行政替代理论：不同于传统规制（约束行为但保留选择），行政替代直接取代选择本身；2. 边际抑制理论：消除决策点会阻碍社会信息生成、错误纠正和适应变化；3. 宪法沉默理论：宪法对政府干预范围的沉默为行政替代创造了空间。
AI.method: 案例研究法：以公共教育为案例，分析行政替代如何剥夺家庭对子女教育的实质性权威；理论分析法：分析行政替代与边际抑制的理论机制；比较分析法：对比行政替代与传统规制的区别。
AI.findings: 1. 宪法对政府干预范围的沉默导致了系统性行政替代；2. 行政替代不同于传统规制，直接取代选择本身（如行政定价取代市场发现、许可取代进入、担保取代风险承担、制度分配取代家庭权威）；3. 这导致了边际抑制，消除社会适应变化的决策点；4. 以公共教育为例，行政替代剥夺了家庭对子女教育的实质性权威；5. 近期拒绝Chevron尊重的判决恢复了司法对法律解释的责任，但未解决这一结构性问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 发展了行政替代理论框架，区分行政替代与传统规制；2. 提出了边际抑制概念，解释消除决策点的社会后果；3. 深化了对宪法沉默如何影响政府干预范围的理解；4. 为分析政府干预与私人选择的关系提供了新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提出宪法修正案建议，以恢复决策边际同时保留必要规制；2. 为政策制定者提供了识别和避免行政替代的框架；3. 为司法实践提供了分析政府干预界限的新工具；4. 为教育改革等具体领域提供了减少行政替代的实践指导。

title: Existence Is Not Enough: Computability and Competitive Equilibrium

detail.title: Existence Is Not Enough: Computability and Competitive Equilibrium
detail.abstract: Competitive equilibrium theory assures us that supporting prices exist under familiar regularity conditions. In the Arrow-Debreu framework, these prices decentralize efficient allocations in economies satisfying standard convexity assumptions. These existence theorems are among the central achievements of modern economics. This note asks a complementary question: can those prices be discovered by feasible processes of adjustment? Existence alone does not guarantee that anyone-agents, institutions, or algorithms-can actually find the prices that coordinate decentralized plans. A price vector that exists but cannot be discovered may be theoretically elegant but operationally irrelevant. I show that equilibrium analysis requires a distinction between logical existence and computational accessibility. The former is a geometric property of an economy; the latter concerns whether feasible processes of adjustment, inference, or learning can locate the equilibrium.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨了竞争均衡理论中价格的存在性与可发现性之间的区别，指出即使均衡价格在理论上存在，也不意味着能够通过可行的调整过程被发现。
AI.research_question: 均衡价格是否能够通过可行的调整过程被发现？
AI.motivation: 竞争均衡理论证明了在标准条件下均衡价格的存在性，但存在性本身并不能保证这些价格能够被实际发现。一个存在但无法被发现的价格向量可能在理论上优雅但在操作上无关紧要。
AI.theoretical_framework: Arrow-Debreu竞争均衡理论，凸性假设，均衡存在性定理
AI.method: 理论分析，区分逻辑存在性与计算可及性
AI.findings: 均衡分析需要区分逻辑存在性与计算可及性。前者是经济的几何性质，后者关注可行的调整、推断或学习过程能否定位均衡。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了均衡价格的可发现性问题，区分了逻辑存在性与计算可及性，为均衡理论增加了操作层面的考量。
AI.practical_contributions: 提醒政策制定者和经济机构，仅仅知道均衡存在是不够的，需要设计可行的机制来发现这些均衡价格。

title: Public Factories
affiliations: Vanderbilt Law School and

detail.title: Public Factories

publicationDetails.journalName: Vanderbilt University Law School Legal Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
The United States is confronting a new era of recurring shortages and risky geopolitical dependencies in essential goods, from medical supplies to semiconductors, revealing vulnerabilities in globalized supply chains and market-driven production. Scholars and policymakers have debated a range of tools to address scarcity: from tariffs and derisking subsidies and tax credits to reshore production, to deregulation and de-proceduralization to speed production, to competition policies to diversify production. 

In this Article, we offer another approach to the problem of scarcity and at-risk supply: public factories. Public factories are government-owned production facilities that exist to provide (or expand) the supply of important goods. Perhaps surprisingly, throughout American history the U.S. federal government, states, and localities have regularly turned to public factories to produce important goods across defense, steel, agriculture, healthcare, and other sectors. We describe this forgotten American tradition from the founding of the country until the present. 

As a policy tool, public factories have a variety of benefits, and some drawbacks and tradeoffs. Drawing on historical examples, we offer a theory of public factories, including explaining why public factories have been deployed and how they have been and can be designed. We argue, again surprisingly, that when implemented well, public factories may be more efficient and effective than subsidizing private manufacturing. 

Public factories are also a particularly ripe tool for policymakers today. In the post-Cold War, post-neoliberal era, policymakers may be more willing to embrace public action to improve supply than they have been in decades. Public factories also address many of the drawbacks of tariffs and derisking policies like subsidies. And they offer a path through the abundance-antimonopoly debate, by providing a strategy that can increase supply while enhancing competition. We conclude by outlining a few pathways by which public factories could also be adopted with and without new federal legislation, thus making them a practical and politically viable addition to the production toolkit.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"公共工厂"作为应对美国关键商品短缺和供应链脆弱性的新政策工具，回顾了美国历史上的公共工厂传统，论证了其相对于私人制造补贴的潜在优势，并探讨了在当前政治环境下的实施路径。
AI.research_question: 公共工厂能否作为应对关键商品短缺和供应链脆弱性的有效政策工具？如何设计公共工厂以提升效率并增强竞争？
AI.motivation: 美国面临医疗用品、半导体等关键商品周期性短缺和地缘政治依赖风险，现有政策工具（关税、补贴、去风险化、放松管制等）存在局限性，需要探索新的解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公共工厂理论：政府所有生产设施作为提供重要商品供应的政策工具；历史制度主义视角下的美国公共工厂传统；比较政策工具分析框架。
AI.method: 历史案例分析法：梳理美国从建国至今在国防、钢铁、农业、医疗等领域的公共工厂实践；比较政策分析：评估公共工厂相对于关税、补贴等传统工具的优势。
AI.findings: 1) 美国历史上存在丰富的公共工厂传统；2) 设计良好的公共工厂可能比补贴私人制造更高效有效；3) 公共工厂能同时增加供应并增强竞争，避免关税和补贴政策的弊端。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 建立公共工厂作为独立政策工具的理论框架；2) 重新发现美国公共工厂的历史传统；3) 提出后冷战、后新自由主义时代公共行动的新范式。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为政策制定者提供具体的公共工厂实施路径；2) 提出无需新联邦立法的实施方案；3) 为解决"充足供应-反垄断"争论提供实践路径。

title: Heterogeneity and the Transmission of Fiscal Policy
affiliations: London School of Economics and

detail.title: Heterogeneity and the Transmission of Fiscal Policy
detail.abstract: How does fiscal policy propagate in an economy with heterogeneous households and sectoral production linkages? We study this question in a model that jointly features demand-side and supply-side heterogeneity. We uncover a novel heterogeneityin-heterogeneity channel: fiscal multipliers depend on how households employed in different industries differ in their income and wealth characteristics. We discipline the model using U.S. sectoral and micro-level data and show that this channel accounts for roughly one third of fiscal policy transmission. Tracking sector-specific income and wealth distributions, we further document substantial cross-industry and within-industry distributional costs of fiscal policy that are absent from more aggregated frameworks.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了在异质性家庭和部门生产关联的经济体中财政政策的传导机制，发现了一个新的"异质性中的异质性"渠道：财政乘数取决于不同行业就业家庭的收入和财富特征差异。
AI.research_question: 在具有异质性家庭和部门生产关联的经济体中，财政政策如何传导？
AI.motivation: 现有研究往往忽视家庭异质性和部门关联对财政政策传导的影响，需要更细致的分析框架来理解财政政策在现实经济中的实际效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合需求侧和供给侧异质性的理论模型，强调"异质性中的异质性"渠道，即财政乘数取决于不同行业就业家庭的收入和财富特征差异。
AI.method: 构建包含异质性家庭和部门生产关联的理论模型，并使用美国部门层面和微观数据进行校准和实证分析。
AI.findings: 1. "异质性中的异质性"渠道解释了约三分之一的财政政策传导；2. 财政政策存在显著的跨行业和行业内分配成本，这些在更聚合的框架中被忽略。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"异质性中的异质性"这一新的理论渠道，为理解财政政策在异质性经济中的传导机制提供了更精细的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了更准确的财政政策效果评估工具，揭示了财政政策对不同行业和收入群体的分配影响，有助于设计更具针对性的财政政策。

title: The Medical Expansion, Life Expectancy, and Endogenous Directed Technical Change
affiliations: University of Pennsylvania, University of Pennsylvania and European University Institute

detail.title: The Medical Expansion, Life Expectancy, and Endogenous Directed Technical Change
detail.abstract:
We build a unified quantitative theory of increasing adult life expectancy and income growth in the last two centuries, and the emergence of a modern health sector in the 20th century. We interpret the data as three phases of a dynamic equilibrium in which households are initially poor, the price of health goods is prohibitively high, and life expectancy is stagnant. As technological progress fuels income growth, households commence consuming basic health goods and life expectancy rises in the first half of the 19th century. 100 years later, further directed technological progress leads to the emergence of a modern health sector. Through the lens of the model, the quality-adjusted relative price of modern health goods declined by about 2.5% per year between 1940 and 2020 while the model-implied relative price that lacks quality adjustment increases in line with the BEA health price index. Counterfactual analyses suggest that almost one fourth of adult life expectancy gains between 1940 and 2020 are attributed to the emergence and expansion of modern health and that public spending on health R&D during World War II played an important role in the kickoff of the modern health sector.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建了一个统一量化理论，解释了过去两个世纪成人预期寿命增长、收入增长以及20世纪现代医疗部门出现的动态均衡过程。
AI.research_question: 成人预期寿命增长、收入增长和现代医疗部门出现之间有何动态关系？如何量化解释这些现象在过去两个世纪的发展过程？
AI.motivation: 理解过去两个世纪中成人预期寿命显著增长、收入持续增长以及现代医疗部门出现的背后机制，这些现象虽然被广泛观察但缺乏统一的理论解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态均衡理论框架，包含三个阶段：初始贫困阶段、基本医疗消费阶段和现代医疗部门发展阶段。强调技术进步的驱动作用，特别是定向技术进步对医疗部门的影响。
AI.method: 构建统一量化理论模型，结合历史数据分析，进行反事实分析。使用质量调整的相对价格计算，比较模型隐含价格与BEA医疗价格指数。
AI.findings: 1. 质量调整的现代医疗商品相对价格在1940-2020年间每年下降约2.5%；2. 1940-2020年间成人预期寿命增长的近四分之一归因于现代医疗的出现和扩张；3. 二战期间公共医疗研发支出对现代医疗部门的启动起了重要作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了解释成人预期寿命增长、收入增长和现代医疗部门出现的统一动态均衡理论，填补了现有文献的空白，为理解长期经济发展与健康关系提供了新框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了量化分析工具，强调了公共研发投资对医疗部门发展的重要性，对发展中国家医疗体系建设具有借鉴意义。

title: Changes in Health Inequalities among Older Individuals in Japan
affiliations: Hitotsubashi University and University of Tokyo

detail.title: Changes in Health Inequalities among Older Individuals in Japan
detail.abstract:
This study examined how health inequalities with respect to income have changed among older adults in Japan from 2001 to 2022. The past two decades have witnessed a series of public pension reforms and increased labor force participation among older individuals. The pro-rich concentration of good health has become less clear for self-rated health and activities of daily living among older men. However, income-related inequality in stress/anxiety increased over time in men, and no clear trend was observed for health deficiencies or conditions. Compared to men, women showed more mixed results, with widening inequalities in health deficiencies and conditions.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析了2001年至2022年间日本老年人健康不平等与收入关系的变化。研究发现，男性老年人的自评健康和日常生活活动方面的亲富健康集中现象减弱，但压力/焦虑方面的收入相关不平等加剧。女性则显示出更复杂的结果，健康缺陷和疾病方面的不平等有所扩大。
AI.research_question: 日本老年人健康不平等（与收入相关）在2001年至2022年间发生了怎样的变化？
AI.motivation: 过去二十年日本经历了公共养老金改革和老年人劳动力参与率增加，这些政策和社会变化可能影响了老年人的健康不平等状况，需要系统研究这些变化趋势。
AI.theoretical_framework: 健康不平等理论，收入与健康关系的社会决定因素理论，老龄化与健康的社会经济梯度理论。
AI.method: 纵向数据分析，使用2001年至2022年期间日本老年人的健康调查数据，分析收入与多种健康指标（自评健康、日常生活活动、压力/焦虑、健康缺陷和疾病）之间的不平等变化趋势。
AI.findings: 1. 男性老年人中，自评健康和日常生活活动方面的亲富健康集中现象减弱；2. 男性压力/焦虑方面的收入相关不平等随时间加剧；3. 男性健康缺陷或疾病方面无明显趋势；4. 女性显示出更复杂的结果，健康缺陷和疾病方面的不平等有所扩大。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提供了日本老年人健康不平等动态变化的新证据；2. 揭示了不同健康指标对收入不平等的不同响应模式；3. 强调了性别在健康不平等变化中的差异作用；4. 为理解政策改革（如养老金改革）对健康不平等的影响提供了实证基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了针对不同性别和健康领域的精准干预依据；2. 建议关注男性老年人的心理健康不平等问题；3. 提示需要特别关注女性老年人的健康缺陷和疾病不平等扩大趋势；4. 为评估养老金改革等政策对健康平等的影响提供了参考。

title: Homemade Foreign Trading
affiliations: Stanford University, Central University of Finance and Economics and University of International Business and Economics - School of Banking and Finance

detail.title: Homemade Foreign Trading
detail.abstract:
Using cross-border holding data from all custodians in China’s Stock Connect, we provide evidence that Chinese mainland insiders evade see-through surveillance by round-tripping via the program. Following the 2018 Northbound Investor Identification reform, the return predictability of northbound flows decays, as does their correlation with insider trading. This reduction is especially pronounced among less prestigious foreign custodians and cross-operating mainland custodians, where insiders are more likely to hide. Furthermore, the reform erodes price informativeness, particularly in stocks with high exposure to homemade foreign investors. Our analysis highlights the role of regulatory cooperation in capital market integration.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用中国沪深港通跨境持股数据，发现中国内地内幕交易者通过该机制进行"往返交易"规避穿透式监管。2018年北向投资者识别改革后，北向资金回报可预测性下降，与内幕交易相关性减弱，价格信息效率降低，特别是在"自制外资"持股高的股票中。
AI.research_question: 沪深港通机制是否被中国内地内幕交易者用于规避穿透式监管？2018年北向投资者识别改革如何影响这种规避行为和市场效率？
AI.motivation: 资本市场监管面临跨境监管挑战，沪深港通作为重要跨境投资渠道可能存在监管漏洞，内幕交易者可能利用该机制规避内地穿透式监管。
AI.theoretical_framework: 监管套利理论、内幕交易理论、市场效率理论、跨境监管合作理论
AI.method: 使用中国沪深港通所有托管机构的跨境持股数据，采用实证分析方法，比较2018年北向投资者识别改革前后的变化，分析不同托管机构类型的影响差异。
AI.findings: 1. 内地内幕交易者通过沪深港通进行"往返交易"规避监管；2. 2018年改革后北向资金回报可预测性下降；3. 改革后北向资金与内幕交易相关性减弱；4. 这种效应在声誉较低的外国托管机构和跨境运营的内地托管机构中更明显；5. 改革降低了价格信息效率，特别是在"自制外资"持股高的股票中。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次实证证明跨境投资渠道被用于监管套利；2. 揭示了跨境监管合作对市场效率的影响机制；3. 丰富了内幕交易和监管套利理论在跨境环境中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为监管机构提供跨境监管合作有效性的证据；2. 帮助识别监管漏洞和风险较高的托管机构类型；3. 为资本市场一体化政策制定提供参考。

title: Declining Occupations and Career Outcomes in Norway
affiliations: Institute for Social Research, Norway, University of New Mexico - Institute for Social Research, Wellesley College and Harvard University - Entrepreneurial Management Unit

detail.title: Declining Occupations and Career Outcomes in Norway
detail.abstract:
Occupational change is a central feature of modern labor markets. This paper examines the career consequences in Norway of being initially employed in an occupation that subsequently declines during 2007–2024. Workers initially employed in occupations that later decline by at least 25% demonstrate 0.4 lower future years of work, although this employment difference is mostly explained by other individual traits. These workers, conditional on controls, experience a 4.7% reduction in future cumulative earnings relative to starting earnings, akin to losing one year’s worth of earnings over 2007–2024.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 研究挪威劳动力市场中，初始职业在2007-2024年间衰退对工人职业生涯的影响。发现初始职业衰退至少25%的工人未来工作年限减少0.4年，未来累计收入减少4.7%（相当于损失一年收入）。
AI.research_question: 初始就业于后来衰退的职业对工人的职业生涯（工作年限和累计收入）有何影响？
AI.motivation: 职业变化是现代劳动力市场的核心特征，了解职业衰退对工人长期职业生涯的影响对于劳动力市场政策和职业规划具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于职业变化理论、人力资本理论和劳动力市场匹配理论，探讨职业衰退对工人职业生涯的长期影响。
AI.method: 使用挪威2007-2024年的劳动力市场数据，通过计量经济学方法分析初始职业衰退对工人未来工作年限和累计收入的影响，控制个体特征变量。
AI.findings: 1. 初始职业衰退至少25%的工人未来工作年限减少0.4年；2. 这种就业差异主要由其他个体特征解释；3. 在控制变量后，这些工人未来累计收入减少4.7%（相当于损失一年收入）。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 量化了职业衰退对工人职业生涯的长期影响；2. 揭示了职业变化与人力资本积累的关系；3. 为职业变化理论提供了实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为劳动力市场政策制定提供依据；2. 帮助工人进行职业规划和风险管理；3. 为职业培训和教育政策提供参考。

title: Health Inequalities among Retirees in the Netherlands
affiliations: Utrecht University and University of Southern California - Center for Economic and Social Research (CESR)

detail.title: Health Inequalities among Retirees in the Netherlands
detail.abstract:
In the Netherlands, life expectancy has continued to rise over the last two decades and the distribution of the age of death has narrowed, which suggests a decrease in health inequality. For the same period, however, the income-mortality gradient has increased, which suggests that the health gains have been unequally distributed across the income distribution. We examine the latter suggestion using data for the Netherlands of the longitudinal Survey of Health, Ageing and Retirement in Europe. Our empirical findings show no significant changes in income-based physical and mental health inequalities during the last two decades. Arguably, larger samples, such as administrative data which is often used to analyze the income-mortality gradient, are needed to investigate in more detail the evolution of physical and mental health inequalities before drawing firm conclusions.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 荷兰过去20年预期寿命上升且死亡年龄分布收窄，但收入-死亡率梯度增加，表明健康收益分配不均。然而使用SHARE数据研究发现，基于收入的身心健康不平等在过去20年并无显著变化。
AI.research_question: 荷兰过去20年间基于收入的身心健康不平等是否发生了变化？
AI.motivation: 荷兰预期寿命持续上升且死亡年龄分布收窄，表面上显示健康不平等减少，但收入-死亡率梯度却在增加，这种矛盾现象需要深入研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 健康不平等理论，收入-健康梯度理论，社会流行病学中的健康决定因素理论。
AI.method: 使用欧洲健康、老龄化和退休调查（SHARE）的纵向数据进行分析，研究荷兰过去20年间基于收入的身心健康不平等变化。
AI.findings: 研究发现，在过去20年间，荷兰基于收入的身心健康不平等没有发生显著变化。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了仅凭死亡率数据推断健康不平等变化的简单假设，强调需要区分不同健康维度（身体vs心理）的不平等测量。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议使用更大样本（如行政数据）来更详细地研究身心健康不平等的演变，为政策制定提供更准确的证据基础。

title: Treasury Supply Shocks: Propagation Through Debt Expansion and Maturity Adjustment
affiliations: Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City, Swiss National Bank and Texas A&M University - Department of Economics

detail.title: Treasury Supply Shocks: Propagation Through Debt Expansion and Maturity Adjustment
detail.abstract:
Historically high debt-to-GDP levels in the U.S. have raised concerns about future financial market stability and fiscal sustainability. We use high-frequency data and consider Treasury futures price changes within narrow windows around auction announcements in order to identify two distinct Treasury supply shocks: debt volume shocks that capture changes in the level of public debt, and maturity adjustment shocks that reflect changes in the maturity structure. We find that debt expansion shocks raise yields across the curve by increasing term premia, leading to tighter financial conditions. These shocks crowd out private sector activity by reducing investment and production, particularly during periods of rapid debt growth. In contrast, maturity extension shocks steepen the yield curve while lowering credit risk premia and fiscal uncertainty. By reducing risk premia, these shocks stimulate near-term investment and production, even as higher long-term borrowing costs weigh on longer-horizon investment. We also show that the Treasury debt management policy can meaningfully interact with the Federal Reserve's asset purchase programs.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文使用高频数据和国债拍卖窗口分析，识别了两种国债供给冲击：债务规模冲击和期限结构调整冲击。研究发现债务扩张冲击通过提高期限溢价推升收益率，收紧金融条件，挤出私人部门活动；而期限延长冲击则通过降低风险溢价刺激短期投资，尽管长期借贷成本上升。
AI.research_question: 美国高债务-GDP比率背景下，国债供给冲击（包括债务规模变化和期限结构调整）如何影响金融市场稳定、财政可持续性和实体经济？
AI.motivation: 美国历史性的高债务-GDP比率引发了对未来金融市场稳定和财政可持续性的担忧，需要理解国债供给冲击的宏观经济影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于国债供给冲击的宏观经济传导机制，包括期限溢价渠道、风险溢价渠道和金融条件渠道，分析不同冲击类型对收益率曲线、投资和生产的影响。
AI.method: 使用高频数据，分析国债拍卖公告窄窗口内的国债期货价格变化，识别债务规模冲击和期限结构调整冲击，采用事件研究法进行因果推断。
AI.findings: 1. 债务扩张冲击提高整条收益率曲线的期限溢价，收紧金融条件，挤出私人投资和生产；2. 期限延长冲击陡化收益率曲线但降低信用风险溢价和财政不确定性，刺激短期投资；3. 国债债务管理政策与美联储资产购买计划存在显著交互作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 区分了两种不同类型的国债供给冲击及其传导机制；2. 揭示了期限结构调整通过风险溢价渠道对实体经济的刺激作用；3. 提供了国债管理与货币政策交互作用的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了债务管理工具选择的实证依据；2. 揭示了在债务高企环境下，期限结构调整可作为刺激经济的政策工具；3. 为理解国债供给冲击的宏观经济后果提供了决策参考。

title: Measuring the Impact of Data Centers in the United States Economy: Monetary Damage from Air Pollution and Greenhouse Gas Emissions
affiliations: Carnegie Mellon University - David A. Tepper School of Business

detail.title: Measuring the Impact of Data Centers in the United States Economy: Monetary Damage from Air Pollution and Greenhouse Gas Emissions
detail.abstract:
This paper quantifies the environmental externalities associated with electricity consumption by data centers in the United States, focusing on damages from local air pollution and greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions. Using facility-level data for approximately 2,800 operational data centers in 2025, combined with electricity grid characteristics and emissions data, the analysis estimates pollution impacts through the AP4 integrated assessment model and applies the social cost of carbon for GHG valuation. Results indicate that data centers consume roughly 250 TWh of electricity—about 5–6% of U.S. generation—and generate approximately $25 billion in gross external damages (GED), with a range of $10–$33 billion. These damages are highly geographically concentrated, with Texas and Virginia accounting for 30% of the national total. While GED comprises about 5% of industry GDP, this ratio varies widely across states, exceeding GDP in some regions. Planned data center expansion could increase electricity demand and associated damages by up to 85% in the near term. Despite these environmental costs, preliminary comparisons suggest that the damages attributable to AI-related energy use are small relative to potential productivity gains.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究量化了美国数据中心电力消耗的环境外部性，发现数据中心消耗约250TWh电力（占美国发电量的5-6%），造成约250亿美元的总外部损害，主要集中在德克萨斯州和弗吉尼亚州。虽然损害占行业GDP约5%，但计划中的扩张可能使电力需求和相关损害增加85%。
AI.research_question: 美国数据中心电力消耗造成的环境外部性（当地空气污染和温室气体排放损害）有多大？这些损害如何在地理上分布？与行业GDP相比如何？未来扩张可能带来什么影响？
AI.motivation: 数据中心作为数字经济的核心基础设施，电力消耗巨大且快速增长，但其环境外部性（空气污染和温室气体排放）尚未得到充分量化。了解这些损害对于制定环境政策、能源规划和可持续发展至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 环境经济学中的外部性理论、社会成本评估框架、AP4综合评估模型用于污染影响分析、社会碳成本用于温室气体估值。
AI.method: 使用约2,800个运营数据中心（2025年）的设施级数据，结合电网特征和排放数据，通过AP4综合评估模型估算污染影响，应用社会碳成本进行温室气体估值。
AI.findings: 1. 数据中心消耗约250TWh电力（占美国发电量5-6%）；2. 造成约250亿美元总外部损害（范围100-330亿美元）；3. 损害高度集中：德克萨斯州和弗吉尼亚州占全国总量的30%；4. 损害占行业GDP约5%，但各州差异大，部分地区超过GDP；5. 计划扩张可能使电力需求和损害增加85%。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次系统量化了美国数据中心的环境外部性；2. 提供了设施级的环境损害地理分布分析；3. 建立了数据中心电力消耗与环境损害之间的量化关系；4. 为数字基础设施的环境影响评估提供了方法论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了数据中心环境成本的具体数据；2. 揭示了环境损害的地理热点，有助于针对性监管；3. 为能源规划和电网投资决策提供依据；4. 为企业选址和可持续发展战略提供参考；5. 虽然AI相关能源使用的损害相对于潜在生产力增益较小，但仍需关注。

title: Organizational Targets in General Equilibrium
affiliations: Yale University,  and Princeton University - Department of Economics

detail.title: Organizational Targets in General Equilibrium
detail.abstract:
We build a general equilibrium model in which firms endogenously choose whether to target prices or quantities. We characterize how these choices of organizational targets depend on firms' uncertainty about microeconomic and macroeconomic factors. In equilibrium, the transmission of both nominal and real shocks hinges on firms' organizational targets. For example, under otherwise identical microfoundations, money is neutral under quantity targets and non-neutral under price targets. We further characterize how targets shape firms' strategic interactions and prove that the macroeconomic uncertainty that arises from each choice of targets reinforces incentives to choose that target. That is, choices of organizational targets are strategic complements. For this reason, monetary policy aimed at stabilization can backfire by inducing a regime shift that renders it ineffective. A simple quantification suggests that incentives over organizational targets can vary markedly at business-cycle frequencies and help explain the state-dependent pass-through of monetary shocks to prices and output.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建了一个一般均衡模型，分析企业如何内生选择价格目标或数量目标，以及这种选择如何影响宏观经济冲击的传导机制。
AI.research_question: 企业如何内生选择价格目标或数量目标？这些组织目标选择如何影响名义和实际冲击的宏观经济传导？
AI.motivation: 理解企业在不确定环境下选择价格目标还是数量目标的决策机制，以及这种选择如何影响货币政策传导和经济波动。
AI.theoretical_framework: 一般均衡理论、企业组织目标选择理论、战略互补性理论、货币非中性理论
AI.method: 构建理论模型，企业内生选择价格或数量目标，分析在微观和宏观经济不确定性下的均衡选择，并进行量化分析
AI.findings: 1. 货币中性取决于企业目标选择：数量目标下货币中性，价格目标下货币非中性；2. 组织目标选择具有战略互补性；3. 稳定性的货币政策可能适得其反，引发制度转变使其失效；4. 组织目标激励在商业周期频率上显著变化
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将企业组织目标选择内生化到一般均衡框架；2. 揭示了目标选择如何决定货币政策的传导机制；3. 提出了组织目标选择的战略互补性理论；4. 解释了货币政策传导的状态依赖性
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为理解货币政策传导的异质性提供新视角；2. 揭示了稳定政策可能引发的非预期后果；3. 帮助企业理解在不同经济环境下选择组织目标的策略；4. 为政策制定者设计更有效的宏观经济政策提供参考

title: The Macroeconomic Effects of Tariffs: Insights from 180 Years of U.S. Trade Policy
affiliations: , Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco, Northwestern University and Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco

detail.title: The Macroeconomic Effects of Tariffs: Insights from 180 Years of U.S. Trade Policy
detail.abstract:
We study the macroeconomic effects of tariff policy using U.S. historical data from 1840–2024. We construct a narrative series of plausibly exogenous tariff changes – based on major legislative actions, multilateral negotiations, and temporary surcharges – and use it as an instrument to identify a structural tariff shock. Tariff increases are contractionary: imports fall sharply, exports decline with a lag, and output and manufacturing activity drop persistently. The shock transmits through both supply and demand channels. Prices rise in the full sample but fall post-World War II, a pattern consistent with changes in the monetary policy response and with stronger international retaliation and reciprocity in the modern trade regime.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 使用1840-2024年美国历史数据研究关税政策的宏观经济效应。构建外生关税变化叙事序列，识别结构性关税冲击。关税增加具有紧缩效应：进口急剧下降，出口滞后下降，产出和制造业活动持续下滑。冲击通过供给和需求渠道传导。全样本中价格上涨，但二战后价格下降，这与货币政策反应变化及现代贸易体制中更强的国际报复和互惠一致。
AI.research_question: 关税政策对宏观经济有什么影响？关税冲击如何通过经济渠道传导？关税效应的历史模式如何随时间变化？
AI.motivation: 理解关税政策的宏观经济效应对于贸易政策制定至关重要。现有研究对关税影响存在争议，且缺乏长期历史视角。需要识别外生关税冲击来建立因果关系，并考察不同历史时期关税效应的变化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际贸易理论、宏观经济学中的总供给-总需求框架、关税传导机制理论、货币政策与贸易政策的交互作用理论。
AI.method: 使用1840-2024年美国历史数据，构建基于主要立法行动、多边谈判和临时附加费的外生关税变化叙事序列，作为工具变量识别结构性关税冲击。采用计量经济学方法分析关税冲击对进口、出口、产出、制造业活动和价格的影响。
AI.findings: 关税增加具有紧缩效应：进口急剧下降，出口滞后下降，产出和制造业活动持续下滑。关税冲击通过供给和需求渠道传导。全样本中价格上涨，但二战后价格下降，这与货币政策反应变化及现代贸易体制中更强的国际报复和互惠一致。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了关税冲击传导机制的理论框架，区分了供给和需求渠道。揭示了关税效应随时间变化的模式，特别是二战后价格反应的反转。为理解货币政策与贸易政策的交互作用提供了理论洞见。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关税政策宏观经济效应的经验证据，支持关税增加具有紧缩效应的结论。揭示了现代贸易体制下国际报复和互惠的重要性。为贸易政策设计提供了历史教训，特别是在考虑关税政策的宏观经济后果时。

title: Physical Proof of Cognitive Quality: A New Paradigm for Human Feedback in AI Alignment
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Physical Proof of Cognitive Quality: A New Paradigm for Human Feedback in AI Alignment

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author(s) is the initiator and lead architect of the NUMEN Protocol and the AETHER architecture discussed in this manuscript. The primary objective of this paper is to establish an open-source, mathematically verifiable epistemological framework for AI alignment, rather than to promote a specific commercial product. The author holds no conflicting financial interests with existing LLM developers or tech monopolies.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This manuscript proposes a theoretical framework and protocol architecture. No new human subject experiments or clinical trials were conducted specifically for the writing of this paper; thus, formal Institutional Review Board (IRB) approval was not required. Furthermore, the proposed NUMEN framework mandates that all biometric data processing utilizes Zero-Knowledge (ZK) proofs to guarantee absolute user anonymity and data sovereignty.
declarations.funderStatement: This theoretical research and protocol design received no external funding from commercial AI laboratories, technology monopolies, or state-sponsored entities. It was independently supported to ensure absolute neutrality and academic integrity in proposing a decentralized AI alignment infrastructure.

detail.abstract: The quality of human feedback is the binding constraint of AI alignment. Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) — the dominant technique for aligning large language models — collects human judgments with no verified information about the annotator’s cognitive state at the time of annotation. Fatigued, anxious, or cognitively biased annotators produce feedback that systematically degrades reward model quality, and therefore AI behavior. This paper introduces Physical Proof of Cognitive Quality (PPCQ): a physically verifiable, cryptographically signed credential that certifies a human’s cognitive state at the moment of providing AI training feedback. PPCQ is produced by NUMEN Protocol, a blockchain-based witnessing system that uses multi-modal biometric sensors to detect a specific high-coherence state of human awareness we define as the Stillness Event. We argue that (1) present-moment awareness states demonstrably reduce cognitive bias and improve judgment quality; (2) RLHF reward model quality is directly limited by the cognitive quality of human annotators; and therefore (3) RLHF data generated during verified Stillness Events carries fundamentally superior epistemic properties. Weighting training data by PPCQ credentials represents a tractable, infrastructure-level approach to reducing AI hallucination and alignment drift at the source. The timing of this proposal is not incidental. Two structural conditions have converged for the first time: AI companies face historically unprecedented demand for high-quality human feedback as language becomes the primary interface between humans and AI systems; and emerging economic frameworks are beginning to recognize non-traditional forms of human contribution as legitimate sources of value. NUMEN Protocol emerges at this intersection. We present the conceptual framework, the scientific foundations across two bodies of literature, and a three-phase experimental program for validating this hypothesis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PPCQ（物理认知质量证明），一种通过区块链和生物传感器验证人类在提供AI训练反馈时认知状态的系统，旨在从根本上提升RLHF数据质量，减少AI幻觉和对齐漂移。
AI.research_question: 如何通过验证人类注释者的认知状态来提升强化学习人类反馈（RLHF）的数据质量，从而改善AI对齐效果？
AI.motivation: 当前RLHF技术收集人类判断时缺乏对注释者认知状态的验证，疲劳、焦虑或认知偏见的注释者会产生系统性降低奖励模型质量的反馈，从而影响AI行为。人类反馈质量是AI对齐的关键约束。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 当下意识状态理论：证明减少认知偏见并提升判断质量；2. RLHF奖励模型质量直接受人类注释者认知质量限制；3. 在验证的"静止事件"期间生成的RLHF数据具有根本上优越的认识论特性。
AI.method: 提出PPCQ（物理认知质量证明）系统，基于NUMEN协议，使用区块链见证系统和多模态生物传感器检测特定的高一致性人类意识状态（定义为"静止事件"）。
AI.findings: 通过PPCQ凭证加权训练数据，代表了一种可操作的、基础设施层面的方法，可以从源头上减少AI幻觉和对齐漂移。该提案的时机恰逢两个结构性条件首次汇聚。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 建立了认知状态与RLHF数据质量之间的理论联系；2. 提出了"静止事件"作为高质量认知状态的操作化定义；3. 发展了物理验证认知质量的新范式。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供可实施的PPCQ系统；2. 为AI公司提供获取高质量人类反馈的解决方案；3. 在新兴经济框架中认可非传统形式的人类贡献价值；4. 提出三阶段实验验证计划。

title: Nudging Parents out the Door: The Impacts of Parental Encouragement on School Choice and Test Scores
affiliations: University of Chicago, University of Chicago, Wageningen University, The World Bank and

detail.title: Nudging Parents out the Door: The Impacts of Parental Encouragement on School Choice and Test Scores
detail.abstract:
This study evaluates a large-scale SMS outreach program to engage caregivers of students in private primary schools in Kenya. Using a two-stage randomization design, we tested two types of weekly SMS messages: growth-mindset encouragement and personalized performance information. We find two main effects: First, outreach improved test scores by 0.07 standard deviations, with particularly strong gains among initially lower-performing students. This improvement generates 12 learning-adjusted years of schooling per US$100 spent—making it highly cost-effective relative to other education interventions. Second, outreach increased student exit rates by 4.7-5.0 percentage points, with effects concentrated among higher-achieving students (5.7 to 6.6 percent-age points). We develop a theoretical model of vertically differentiated schools where parental engagement affects both learning production and school choice. The model shows that when parents update their understanding of education production through engagement programs, they become more sensitive to perceived school quality differences. This increased sensitivity can lead lower-quality schools to forgo implementing engagement programs—even when costless—as enhanced parental discernment accelerates student exits. Our findings suggest a role for third-party provision of parent engagement programs in competitive education markets.
