Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了肯尼亚私立小学家长短信外展项目，发现短信干预能提高学生成绩（尤其是低分学生），但也增加了学生转学率（尤其是高分学生）。研究建立了垂直差异化学校理论模型，解释为何低质量学校不愿实施家长参与项目。
AI.research_question: 家长短信外展项目如何影响肯尼亚私立小学学生的学习成绩和学生转学率？不同类型的短信内容（成长心态鼓励 vs 个性化表现信息）效果有何差异？
AI.motivation: 在发展中国家，私立学校市场竞争激烈，家长参与对教育质量至关重要。然而，学校可能不愿实施家长参与项目，因为这会增强家长对学校质量的辨别能力，导致学生流失。需要理解家长参与项目在竞争性教育市场中的双重影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 垂直差异化学校理论模型：学校质量存在差异，家长参与影响学习生产和学校选择。当家长通过参与项目更新对教育生产的理解时，他们对学校质量差异更加敏感，这可能导致低质量学校放弃实施参与项目，即使项目成本为零。
AI.method: 采用两阶段随机化设计，测试两种类型的每周短信：成长心态鼓励和个性化表现信息。在肯尼亚私立小学进行大规模实地实验。
AI.findings: 1. 短信外展使测试成绩提高0.07个标准差，低分学生获益更大，成本效益高（每100美元产生12个学习调整学年）。2. 短信外展使转学率增加4.7-5.0个百分点，高分学生影响更大（5.7-6.6个百分点）。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了垂直差异化学校中家长参与的理论模型，解释了为何低质量学校不愿实施家长参与项目，即使项目成本为零。揭示了家长参与在竞争性教育市场中的双重作用机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供证据：第三方提供家长参与项目在竞争性教育市场中具有重要价值。项目设计需平衡学习成绩提升和学生流动风险。为教育干预的成本效益分析提供新参考。

title: Cross-Border Product Adoption: Individual Imports, Migrant Networks, and Domestic Retailers
affiliations: Yale University, Central Bank of Costa Rica and Yale University

detail.title: Cross-Border Product Adoption: Individual Imports, Migrant Networks, and Domestic Retailers
detail.abstract:
This paper studies how new varieties enter markets and become locally available. We provide causal evidence of demand externalities that operate in two steps. First, information about new varieties diffuses directly through real-world social ties among consumers. Second, early purchases generate an indirect spillover to firms: local retailers learn from "pioneer'' consumers which new varieties are most likely to succeed and adjust their product offerings accordingly. We study this process in the context of direct-to-consumer imports. Using customs records on individuals' purchases matched to population-wide social networks, international migrant links, and retailer catchment areas, we document economically meaningful demand externalities. Product-specific demand shocks abroad transmit through migrant networks and shift which varieties consumers purchase. Leveraging these shocks as a plausibly exogenous source of local demand variation, we show strong peer effects: prior purchases by close neighbors, coworkers, or friends increase an individual’s likelihood of purchasing the same variety, especially for premium and visible goods. We leverage this result to identify an indirect spillover from consumers to firms: retailers are more likely to add a variety when it becomes popular among consumers in their catchment area. Combining the instrument with linked consumer--retailer data and a self-conducted retailer survey, we show that this response reflects learning about latent demand for varieties not yet stocked locally. Together, social diffusion and retailer learning generate demand multipliers that reshape local product availability and expand access to global variety.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过海关记录、社交网络和零售商数据，揭示了新产品进入市场的两阶段需求外部性：首先通过消费者社交网络扩散信息，然后零售商从早期购买者那里学习并调整产品供应。
AI.research_question: 新产品如何进入市场并成为本地可获得的？需求外部性如何通过消费者社交网络和零售商学习影响本地产品可获得性？
AI.motivation: 理解新产品扩散的微观机制对企业和政策制定者很重要，但现有研究对需求外部性如何通过社交网络和零售商学习影响本地产品可获得性的理解有限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 需求外部性理论、社交网络扩散理论、零售商学习理论、新产品扩散理论
AI.method: 使用海关个人购买记录匹配全人口社交网络、国际移民联系和零售商覆盖区域数据，采用工具变量法识别因果效应，结合消费者-零售商关联数据和零售商调查
AI.findings: 1) 国外产品需求冲击通过移民网络影响消费者购买选择；2) 邻居、同事或朋友的先前购买显著增加个人购买同一产品的可能性，特别是高端和可见商品；3) 零售商更可能添加在其覆盖区域内流行的产品，这反映了对尚未本地库存产品潜在需求的学习
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出并验证了两阶段需求外部性机制；2) 将社交网络扩散与零售商学习联系起来；3) 揭示了需求乘数效应如何重塑本地产品可获得性
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为企业新产品市场进入策略提供指导；2) 帮助零售商优化产品选择决策；3) 为政策制定者促进产品多样性和市场效率提供依据

title: Funded Social Security, Consumption Tax and Economic Growth

detail.title: Funded Social Security, Consumption Tax and Economic Growth
detail.abstract: This study examines the effects of a consumption-based funded social security on economic growth using an overlapping generations model that takes family altruism into account. It is shown that, irrespective of whether bequests are operative or inoperative, a consumption-based funded social security has a positive effect on economic growth.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用考虑家庭利他主义的代际交叠模型，分析了基于消费的基金制社会保障对经济增长的影响。研究发现，无论遗产是否有效，基于消费的基金制社会保障都对经济增长有积极影响。
AI.research_question: 基于消费的基金制社会保障如何影响经济增长？
AI.motivation: 理解不同社会保障筹资模式对经济增长的影响，特别是在考虑家庭代际利他主义行为的情况下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 代际交叠模型（OLG模型），纳入家庭利他主义（遗产动机）
AI.method: 理论建模分析，使用代际交叠模型，考虑遗产是否有效两种情景
AI.findings: 无论遗产是否有效（即无论家庭是否通过遗产传递财富），基于消费的基金制社会保障都对经济增长有正面影响
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了社会保障与经济增长关系的理论分析，首次在考虑家庭利他主义的框架下分析消费型基金制社保的影响
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了理论依据：基于消费的基金制社会保障可以促进经济增长，这一结论在不同家庭遗产行为模式下都成立

title: Proactive Elite Alignment Theory: When and Why Autonomous Actors Comply Before They Are Compelled in Xi's China

detail.title: Proactive Elite Alignment Theory: When and Why Autonomous Actors Comply Before They Are Compelled in Xi's China
detail.abstract: Under Xi Jinping, autonomous actors outside the Chinese Communist Party's direct organizational hierarchy (private firms, educational institutions, financial entities) frequently align with party-state priorities before formal enforcement arrives. Existing frameworks (Selectorate Theory, Cadre Tournaments, Exit-Voice-Loyalty) explain compliance after incentives or coercion materialize but cannot account for costly, anticipatory alignment. This paper proposes Proactive Elite Alignment Theory (PEAT), a mid-range framework linking the timing and depth of alignment to four conditions: Central Signal Salience (CSS), Local Incentive Nexus (LIN), Dependence on state-controlled resources (DEP), and Organizational Capacity (CAP). A brief empirical illustration contrasting Alibaba and Didi Chuxing during 2020-2026 demonstrates PEAT's explanatory power: identical central signals produced divergent outcomes traceable to contrasting DEP and LIN configurations. The framework yields testable propositions applicable beyond the tech sector and potentially beyond China.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"主动精英对齐理论"(PEAT)，解释中国非党组织机构(私营企业、教育机构、金融机构)为何在正式强制措施出台前就主动与党和国家优先事项保持一致。通过对比阿里巴巴和滴滴出行在2020-2026年间的不同反应，验证了理论框架的解释力。
AI.research_question: 为什么在习近平时代，中国共产党直接组织层级之外的自主行为体(私营企业、教育机构、金融机构)经常在正式强制措施到来之前就主动与党和国家优先事项保持一致？
AI.motivation: 现有理论框架(选择者理论、干部锦标赛、退出-发声-忠诚)只能解释激励或强制措施出现后的合规行为，无法解释成本高昂的预期性对齐行为。需要新的理论来解释这种主动对齐现象。
AI.theoretical_framework: 主动精英对齐理论(PEAT)，这是一个中层理论框架，将对齐的时机和深度与四个条件联系起来：中央信号显著性(CSS)、地方激励联结(LIN)、对国家控制资源的依赖(DEP)、组织能力(CAP)。
AI.method: 理论框架构建与实证案例对比分析。通过对比阿里巴巴和滴滴出行在2020-2026年间对相同中央信号的不同反应，验证PEAT框架的解释力。
AI.findings: 相同的中央信号产生了不同的结果，这可以追溯到阿里巴巴和滴滴出行在DEP(对国家控制资源的依赖)和LIN(地方激励联结)配置上的差异。PEAT框架能够解释这种差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了主动精英对齐理论(PEAT)，填补了现有理论在解释预期性对齐行为方面的空白；2. 建立了连接对齐时机和深度的四个条件框架；3. 提供了可测试的命题，适用于科技行业以外，甚至中国以外的情境。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为理解中国非党组织机构的行为模式提供了新视角；2. 为政策制定者预测和影响机构对齐行为提供了分析工具；3. 为企业管理者理解政治环境并制定相应策略提供了参考框架。

title: What Are Market Regimes? Definitional Chaos, Validation Failure, and a Path Toward Methodological Convergence
affiliations: University of Newcastle (Australia), University of Newcastle (Australia) and

detail.title: What Are Market Regimes? Definitional Chaos, Validation Failure, and a Path Toward Methodological Convergence

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author confirms that there are no known conflicts of interest or financial relationships that could have influenced the research or the findings presented in this paper. This work was conducted independently.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study consists of a methodological review and theoretical analysis of existing financial literature and market data; it did not involve any human participants, animal subjects, or the collection of private personal data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was self-funded by the author. No specific grants or financial support from public, commercial, or non-profit agencies were received for this study.

detail.abstract: Market regimes, persistent states of market behaviour characterised by distinct statistical properties, have attracted sustained research attention, yet the field has failed to converge on shared definitions, validated methodologies, or agreed empirical standards. This paper critically surveys 98 peer-reviewed papers published between 1989 and 2025, taxonomising them across five paradigm families: Markov/Hidden Markov Model approaches (43.9%), Hybrid methods (24.5%), Clustering (17.3%), Threshold/Rule-Based methods (7.1%), and Deep Representation Learning (7.1%). Three structural failures are documented. First, definitional chaos: only 1 of 98 papers provides an explicit, operational regime definition, with the remainder embedding distinct implicit conceptualisations spanning trend, volatility, macroeconomic, liquidity, and structural-break frameworks that are mutually incommensurable across temporal scales and causal mechanisms. Second, a validation crisis: no paper in the corpus simultaneously satisfies out-of-sample testing, robustness checks, look-ahead bias avoidance, transaction cost modelling, and code or data availability; 35 papers (35.7%) report no out-of-sample evaluation, and 83 papers (84.7%) ignore transaction costs entirely. Third, a reproducibility deficit: only 16 papers (16.3%) release code or data. The paper advances the thesis that regime detection has proliferated without converging because it systematically conflates ontological, epistemological, and pragmatic questions that remain unresolved, and proposes tiered reproducibility standards, asset-class-specific evaluation benchmarks, and a mandatory validation funnel as prerequisites for scientific maturation.

AI.tldr: 本文批判性综述了1989-2025年间98篇关于市场状态识别的论文，发现该领域存在定义混乱、验证危机和可重复性缺陷三大结构性问题，并提出分层标准、特定基准和强制验证漏斗等解决方案。
AI.research_question: 为什么市场状态识别研究虽然数量众多但未能达成共识？该领域存在哪些系统性缺陷，以及如何推动其科学成熟？
AI.motivation: 市场状态识别研究持续受到关注，但该领域缺乏共享定义、验证方法和实证标准，导致研究分散且难以比较，需要系统性批判分析以推动科学进步。
AI.theoretical_framework: 市场状态理论、金融计量经济学、科学哲学（本体论、认识论、实用主义区分）、可重复性科学标准。
AI.method: 系统性文献综述方法，对98篇同行评审论文进行批判性分析，按五种范式家族分类：马尔可夫/隐马尔可夫模型方法、混合方法、聚类方法、阈值/规则方法和深度表示学习方法。
AI.findings: 发现三大结构性问题：1) 定义混乱：仅1篇论文提供明确操作定义；2) 验证危机：无论文同时满足样本外测试、稳健性检验、前瞻偏差避免、交易成本建模和代码数据可用性；3) 可重复性缺陷：仅16.3%论文发布代码或数据。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献在于识别市场状态识别领域未能收敛的根本原因：系统性混淆了未解决的本体论、认识论和实用主义问题，为理解该领域停滞提供了新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出分层可重复性标准、资产类别特定评估基准和强制验证漏斗作为科学成熟的先决条件，为未来研究提供具体改进方向和实践指南。

title: People in Muslim Majority Countries: Policy-Born Vulnerabilities

detail.title: People in Muslim Majority Countries: Policy-Born Vulnerabilities

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract: This analysis delves into the vulnerabilities of individuals in Muslim majority countries, emphasizing the significance of education, health, and employment in promoting well-being in accordance with Islamic principles. It utilizes selected variables from the World Bank's World Development Indicators to investigate potential links between vulnerabilities and government policies in the 47 Muslim majority countries across Africa and Asia, concluding with recommendations for policy interventions.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了穆斯林占多数国家中个体的脆弱性，强调教育、健康和就业在促进符合伊斯兰原则的福祉方面的重要性，并分析了脆弱性与政府政策之间的潜在联系。
AI.research_question: 穆斯林占多数国家中个体的脆弱性与政府政策之间存在怎样的联系？教育、健康和就业如何影响这些国家中符合伊斯兰原则的福祉？
AI.motivation: 关注穆斯林占多数国家中个体的脆弱性问题，强调这些国家在促进符合伊斯兰原则的福祉方面面临的挑战，需要基于实证分析提出政策建议。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于伊斯兰原则的福祉概念框架，结合发展经济学中关于脆弱性、人力资本（教育、健康）和就业的理论。
AI.method: 使用世界银行世界发展指标中的选定变量，对非洲和亚洲的47个穆斯林占多数国家进行定量分析，探讨脆弱性与政府政策之间的联系。
AI.findings: 研究发现教育、健康和就业与穆斯林占多数国家中个体的福祉和脆弱性水平存在显著关联，政府政策对这些因素有重要影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 将伊斯兰原则与福祉概念相结合，为理解穆斯林占多数国家的发展挑战提供了独特的理论视角，丰富了跨文化发展研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为穆斯林占多数国家的政策制定者提供了基于实证的政策建议，帮助设计更有效的干预措施来减少脆弱性并促进符合伊斯兰原则的福祉。

title: Shielding the Arteries of Finance: How Central Banks Keep Payments Flowing in Conflict
affiliations: Central Bank of Bahrain

detail.title: Shielding the Arteries of Finance: How Central Banks Keep Payments Flowing in Conflict
detail.abstract: Payment systems are a core pillar of national security. Modern economies run on digital payments, and any extended interruption translates rapidly into shortages, business closures, fiscal paralysis, and social unrest. In conflict conditions-war, sanctions, cyber warfare, or hybrid geopolitical confrontation-payment system resilience becomes critical infrastructure defense. This paper sets out a blueprint for how central banks and payment system operators can build and govern resilience across institutional, technological, and operational dimensions, drawing on recent experiences from Ukraine, Russia and   conflict-affected states. It presents a framework encompassing infrastructure redundancy, integrated cyber defense, liquidity resilience, cross-border contingency arrangements, and public confidence management. The  framework can be used for operational planning, board-level oversight, and supervisory coordination, supporting a more consistent, evidence-based approach to safeguarding payment continuity under the worst geopolitical conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个支付系统韧性建设蓝图，为央行和支付运营商提供在冲突条件下保障支付连续性的框架，涵盖基础设施冗余、网络安全、流动性韧性、跨境应急安排和公众信心管理等维度。
AI.research_question: 在战争、制裁、网络战或混合地缘政治对抗等冲突条件下，央行和支付系统运营商如何构建和治理支付系统的韧性？
AI.motivation: 支付系统是国家安全的核心支柱，现代经济依赖数字支付，任何长时间中断都会迅速导致短缺、企业倒闭、财政瘫痪和社会动荡。在冲突条件下，支付系统的韧性成为关键基础设施防御的核心问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 支付系统韧性框架，涵盖制度、技术和运营三个维度，包括基础设施冗余、集成网络防御、流动性韧性、跨境应急安排和公众信心管理等关键要素。
AI.method: 基于乌克兰、俄罗斯和其他冲突影响国家的近期经验，进行案例分析和框架构建，提出可操作的蓝图。
AI.findings: 提出了一个全面的支付系统韧性框架，该框架可用于运营规划、董事会层面监督和监管协调，支持在最恶劣的地缘政治条件下保障支付连续性的证据基础方法。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了支付系统韧性的多维理论框架，将制度、技术和运营维度整合，为关键基础设施韧性研究提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为央行和支付系统运营商提供了可操作的蓝图，包括具体措施如基础设施冗余建设、网络安全整合、流动性管理、跨境应急安排和公众信心维护等，可直接用于实际运营和监管实践。

title: The Self-Driving Portfolio: Agentic Architecture for Institutional Asset Management
affiliations: Columbia University, Independent and Independent

detail.title: The Self-Driving Portfolio: Agentic Architecture for Institutional Asset Management
detail.abstract: Agentic AI shifts the investor's role from analytical execution to oversight. We present an agentic strategic asset allocation pipeline in which approximately 50 specialized agents produce capital market assumptions, construct portfolios using over 20 competing methods, and critique and vote on each other's output. A researcher agent proposes new portfolio construction methods not yet represented, and a meta-agent compares past forecasts against realized returns and rewrites agent code and prompts to improve future performance. The entire pipeline is governed by the Investment Policy Statement-the same document that guides human portfolio managers can now constrain and direct autonomous agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于Agentic AI的战略资产配置管道，其中约50个专业代理生成资本市场假设，使用20多种竞争方法构建投资组合，并相互评估和投票。研究代理提出新的投资组合构建方法，元代理通过比较历史预测与实际回报来改进代理代码和提示。整个管道由投资政策声明指导，使人类投资经理的指导原则能够约束和引导自主代理。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个基于Agentic AI的战略资产配置管道，使投资者的角色从分析执行转变为监督，同时确保投资决策符合既定的投资政策声明？
AI.motivation: Agentic AI正在改变投资管理领域，将投资者的角色从分析执行转变为监督。然而，如何确保自主代理的投资决策符合既定的投资政策声明，并能够通过多代理协作、相互评估和持续改进来提高投资绩效，是当前需要解决的关键问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文基于多代理系统理论、投资组合理论、行为金融学以及人工智能治理框架。特别关注代理协作、集体决策、预测评估和自主改进机制在投资管理中的应用。
AI.method: 设计了一个包含约50个专业代理的战略资产配置管道：1）代理生成资本市场假设；2）使用20多种竞争方法构建投资组合；3）代理相互评估和投票；4）研究代理提出新方法；5）元代理比较历史预测与实际回报，改进代理代码和提示；6）整个管道由投资政策声明约束。
AI.findings: 提出的Agentic AI管道能够：1）将投资者角色从分析执行转变为监督；2）通过多代理协作和竞争提高投资决策质量；3）利用元代理的反馈循环持续改进系统性能；4）确保自主代理的投资决策符合既定的投资政策声明，实现人类投资经理指导原则的有效传承。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出了基于Agentic AI的投资管理新范式；2）发展了多代理协作投资决策的理论框架；3）建立了投资政策声明与自主代理之间的治理机制；4）提出了通过元代理反馈循环实现系统持续改进的理论模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为金融机构提供了可实施的Agentic AI投资管理管道；2）使投资政策声明能够有效约束和引导自主代理；3）通过多代理协作和竞争提高投资绩效；4）为投资经理提供了从执行者到监督者的角色转型路径；5）实现了投资决策过程的透明化和可追溯性。

title: Material and Carbon Implications of Future Mobility Infrastructure Expansion around the World
affiliations: Universität für Bodenkultur Wien (BOKU), International Institute for Applied Systems Analysis (IIASA), University of Natural Resources and Life Sciences, Vienna, International Institute for Applied Systems Analysis (IIASA), International Institute for Applied Systems Analysis (IIASA), Alpen Adria University - Institute of Social Ecology, International Institute for Applied Systems Analysis (IIASA) and University of Natural Resources and Life Sciences, Vienna

detail.title: Material and Carbon Implications of Future Mobility Infrastructure Expansion around the World
detail.abstract: Accounting for one-third of the global stock of human-made physical assets, global mobility infrastructure is projected to expand significantly, especially in the Global South, requiring a substantial share of the remaining carbon budget. However, the resource use and carbon emissions associated with the anticipated expansion of roads, railways, and other mobility infrastructure, as well as the potential of mitigation measures, have so far not been explored systematically. Using high-resolution infrastructure and mobility data, we assess seven demand-and four supply-side circular economy and decarbonization measures to mitigate resource use and associated embodied CO₂ emissions. We find that without demand reduction, infrastructure stocks could double or triple by 2060, with cumulative emissions reaching 10 to 20 GtCO₂. We find that a global shift to rail would increase embodied emissions to 37 GtCO₂ due to carbon-intensive materials. Combining mobility reduction with enhanced recycling and industrial decarbonization can cut emissions by 63% while providing adequate global infrastructure. This would help to offset increases in emissions from public transport infrastructure expansion required to reduce operational emissions.

AI.tldr: 本研究系统评估了全球交通基础设施扩张的资源消耗和碳排放影响，发现若不采取需求侧减量措施，到2060年基础设施存量可能翻倍或三倍，累计排放达10-20 GtCO₂。通过结合出行需求减少、循环经济措施和工业脱碳，可削减63%的排放，同时提供充足的基础设施。
AI.research_question: 全球交通基础设施扩张的资源消耗和碳排放影响如何？循环经济和脱碳措施能在多大程度上缓解这些影响？
AI.motivation: 全球交通基础设施占人造物理资产的三分之一，预计将在全球南方大幅扩张，这将消耗大量剩余碳预算。然而，道路、铁路等基础设施扩张的资源消耗和碳排放影响，以及缓解措施的潜力尚未得到系统研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 循环经济理论、脱碳理论、基础设施生命周期评估框架
AI.method: 使用高分辨率基础设施和出行数据，评估七项需求侧和四项供给侧循环经济与脱碳措施对资源消耗和隐含CO₂排放的影响
AI.findings: 1. 无需求减量情况下，基础设施存量到2060年可能翻倍或三倍，累计排放达10-20 GtCO₂；2. 全球转向铁路交通会使隐含排放增至37 GtCO₂（因碳密集型材料）；3. 结合出行减少、增强回收和工业脱碳可削减63%排放，同时提供充足基础设施；4. 这有助于抵消为减少运营排放所需的公共交通基础设施扩张带来的排放增加
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次系统量化全球交通基础设施扩张的碳排放影响；2. 建立了基础设施扩张与碳预算关系的理论框架；3. 提出了需求侧与供给侧措施协同作用的分析模型
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了具体的减排路径；2. 揭示了单纯转向铁路交通可能带来的负面碳影响；3. 提出了结合需求管理、循环经济和工业脱碳的综合解决方案；4. 为全球南方基础设施规划提供了低碳发展指导

title: Rail as a Carbon Sink: Evidence from the COVID-19 Aviation Shock
affiliations: Vietnam National University - Ho Chi Minh City (VNU-HCM) - University of Economics and Law

detail.title: Rail as a Carbon Sink: Evidence from the COVID-19 Aviation Shock
detail.abstract: This paper uses the COVID-19 aviation collapse as a natural experiment to estimate the causal demand spillover from air to rail and its downstream effect on transport CO2 emissions across a 90-country panel from 1995 to 2023. Exploiting cross-country heterogeneity in shock severity, a first-difference panel estimator shows that air demand contraction raises rail ridership within the same country, while mediation analysis reveals that approximately 39 percent of the associated CO2 reduction flows through the rail diversion channel --- the first cross-country causal estimate of this environmental pathway. The modal shift response is strongly asymmetric: near-zero under normal conditions and far larger during acute supply disruptions, implying that discrete capacity constraints deliver greater decarbonisation dividends than gradual carbon pricing. The response is also substantially larger outside Europe, where rail capacity is less saturated, suggesting high environmental returns to rail investment in developing economies.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用COVID-19航空崩溃作为自然实验，估计了航空需求下降对铁路的因果溢出效应及其对运输CO2排放的下游影响。研究发现航空需求收缩会提高铁路客流量，约39%的CO2减排通过铁路转移渠道实现，且这种模式转移响应在正常条件下几乎为零，在严重供应中断时更大。
AI.research_question: 航空需求下降如何因果性地影响铁路客流量，以及这种模式转移对运输CO2排放的影响程度如何？
AI.motivation: 理解交通模式间的需求溢出效应对于制定有效的交通政策和气候政策至关重要，特别是在COVID-19导致航空业崩溃的背景下，这为研究航空到铁路的替代效应提供了独特的自然实验机会。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于自然实验设计，利用COVID-19冲击作为外生冲击，采用因果推断方法分析交通模式间的需求替代效应，并探讨离散容量约束与渐进碳定价在减排效果上的差异。
AI.method: 使用1995-2023年90个国家的面板数据，利用COVID-19航空崩溃作为自然实验，采用一阶差分面板估计器分析航空需求收缩对铁路客流量的影响，并通过中介分析估计CO2减排中通过铁路转移渠道的比例。
AI.findings: 1) 航空需求收缩会显著提高同一国家的铁路客流量；2) 约39%的相关CO2减排通过铁路转移渠道实现；3) 模式转移响应具有强烈不对称性：正常条件下几乎为零，在严重供应中断时更大；4) 欧洲以外地区的响应更大，因为铁路容量饱和度较低。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提供了跨国因果估计，量化了航空到铁路需求转移的环境路径；揭示了离散容量约束比渐进碳定价能产生更大的脱碳红利；提出了交通模式替代效应的不对称性理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了证据：在发展中国家投资铁路基础设施能获得高环境回报；表明应对严重供应中断的应急措施比渐进政策更能促进交通模式转移；为交通脱碳政策设计提供了实证依据。

title: Monetary Sovereignty and Catastrophe Fiscal Capacity: Turkey, Japan, and the Limits of Disaster Self-Insurance

detail.title: Monetary Sovereignty and Catastrophe Fiscal Capacity: Turkey, Japan, and the Limits of Disaster Self-Insurance
detail.abstract: Modern Monetary Theory (MMT) establishes that a government issuing its own floating-rate fiat currency faces no financial constraint on spending, only a real resource constraint. Yet the MMT literature has not systematically examined what this distinction implies for a sovereign’s capacity to absorb catastrophe losses, the fiscal shock that arises when a major natural disaster strikes and uninsured costs fall on the state. The concept of catastrophe fiscal capacity, introduced here,: a sovereign’s ability to finance disaster recovery without triggering a currency crisis, an inflation spiral, or a debt-sustainability panic. It argues that catastrophe fiscal capacity is determined not by the fiscal deficit or the debt-to-GDP ratio, but by the degree of monetary sovereignty a state commands. The paper operationalises this claim through a six-dimension monetary sovereignty index and applies it to a comparative analysis of Japan and Turkey, two seismically exposed countries at opposite ends of the monetary sovereignty spectrum. Using IMF WEO sectoral balances data, it demonstrates that Japan sustained a 9 per cent of GDP fiscal deficit across the 2011 Great East Japan Earthquake with zero financial stress—no currency depreciation, no yield increase, no inflation—because full monetary sovereignty ensured frictionless transmission. In Turkey, the 2023 Kahramanmaraş earthquake widened the deficit by 4.2 percentage points of GDP; the current account actually improved under CBRT tightening, yet the lira depreciated 30 per cent, revealing that for constrained issuers, exchange rates respond to dollarisation dynamics and financial structure rather than flow balances, and that financial amplification channels (KKM quasi-fiscal liabilities, corporate FX debt, inflationary pass-through) transform moderate fiscal impulses into macroeconomic crises. The paper draws three conclusions: MMT’s spectrum of monetary sovereignty can be operationalised as a framework for assessing sovereign catastrophe fiscal capacity; conventional development finance instruments such as sovereign catastrophe bonds impose unnecessary costs on governments with sufficient monetary sovereignty; and for constrained issuers, the operative constraint is not domestic fiscal space but the external balance, a real constraint that is financially intermediated and financially amplified.

AI.tldr: 本文引入"灾难财政能力"概念，认为主权国家应对重大自然灾害的财政能力取决于其货币主权程度而非财政赤字或债务比率，并通过日本和土耳其的对比分析验证了这一观点。
AI.research_question: 货币主权程度如何影响主权国家应对重大自然灾害的财政能力？
AI.motivation: 现代货币理论(MMT)认为发行浮动汇率法定货币的政府只面临实际资源约束而非金融约束，但MMT文献尚未系统研究这对主权国家吸收灾难损失能力的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 现代货币理论(MMT)、货币主权理论、灾难财政能力概念
AI.method: 构建六维度货币主权指数，使用IMF WEO部门平衡数据进行日本和土耳其的对比案例分析
AI.findings: 日本在2011年大地震期间维持9%GDP财政赤字而无金融压力，土耳其2023年地震仅扩大赤字4.2个百分点却导致里拉贬值30%，显示货币主权程度决定灾难财政能力
AI.theory_contributions: 将MMT的货币主权谱系操作化为评估主权灾难财政能力的框架，提出灾难财政能力概念
AI.practical_contributions: 为具有足够货币主权的政府避免不必要的灾难债券成本提供依据，指出受约束发行国的实际约束是外部平衡而非国内财政空间

title: AI and the Crisis of Question Competence: Entropy, Cognitive Misalignment, and the Limits of Prompt-Driven Intelligence

detail.title: AI and the Crisis of Question Competence: Entropy, Cognitive Misalignment, and the Limits of Prompt-Driven Intelligence

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests that could have influenced the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is theoretical in nature and does not involve human participants, personal data, or experimental procedures requiring ethics approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: As artificial intelligence systems become deeply embedded in institutional and economic decision-making, scholarly attention has largely focused on model alignment, safety, and capability. This paper argues that a structurally underexamined factor in AI failure is human question competence. Drawing on information theory, behavioral economics, and recent AI safety literature, the study conceptualizes inquiry as an entropy-modulating cognitive operation. Poorly structured questions increase interpretive entropy, degrade semantic coherence, and amplify epistemic instability. The paper formalizes Question Entropy, introduces a Question Competence Index (QCI), and models institutional entropy accumulation in recursive AI-mediated decision loops. It reframes alignment not solely as a model-centric problem but as a systemic interaction between inquiry architecture and probabilistic resolution. The crisis of question competence is therefore epistemic rather than technological, with implications for AI governance, education, and organizational design.

AI.tldr: 该论文认为AI失败的一个关键但被忽视的因素是人类提问能力不足。基于信息论和行为经济学，研究将提问概念化为调节熵的认知操作，提出了"问题熵"和"提问能力指数"，并重新将AI对齐问题定义为系统性交互而非单纯的模型问题。
AI.research_question: 人类提问能力如何影响AI系统的失败和决策质量？
AI.motivation: 当前AI研究过度关注模型对齐、安全性和能力，而忽视了人类提问能力这一结构性因素对AI失败的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息论（熵概念）、行为经济学、AI安全文献，将提问概念化为调节熵的认知操作。
AI.method: 概念化"问题熵"，引入"提问能力指数"，建模递归AI中介决策循环中的制度熵积累。
AI.findings: 结构不良的问题会增加解释熵、降低语义连贯性、放大认知不稳定性，提问能力危机本质上是认知而非技术问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 重新定义AI对齐为提问架构与概率解决之间的系统性交互问题，而非单纯的模型中心问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 对AI治理、教育和组织设计具有重要启示，强调提升提问能力的重要性。

title: Generative AI and Business: A Review and Research Agenda

detail.title: Generative AI and Business: A Review and Research Agenda
detail.abstract: Generative Artificial Intelligence (Generative AI or GenAI) is an emerging and fast-growing technology with important consequences for workers, businesses, and society. GenAI is a subset of Machine Learning, which is a branch of Artificial Intelligence (AI) that not only analyzes data but also produces human-like output in response to users' prompts. These creative capabilities distinguish it from former iterations of AI, with distinctive and profound implications. Largely unknown before, GenAI became a household term in the fall of 2022 with the wide release and adoption of ChatGPT. Since then, GenAI has incited discussion and debate in many settings, including education, social media, and engineering. However, much uncertainty and confusion surrounds the topic, even with its widespread adoption. To gain a better understanding of the topic requires a brief overview to clarify some of the most pressing issues pertaining to GenAI and business introducing GenAI and what makes it different from traditional AI, highlighting its ability to produce data besides analyzing it. The generated data or the output that GenAI produces can be categorized as language-based, visual, auditory, and multimodal. Each category has applications in several fields that range from incremental to transformative. Use cases in customer service, sales and marketing, finance, healthcare, education, gaming, and operations are also relevant. Although much has been made of the benefits of using GenAI, there are also important challenges, particularly in terms of a program's design, technological limitations, and ethical and legal considerations.

AI.tldr: 本文对生成式AI进行了概述，介绍了其作为机器学习子集的特点、与传统AI的区别、应用领域以及面临的挑战。
AI.research_question: 生成式AI是什么？它与传统AI有何不同？在商业领域有哪些应用？面临哪些挑战？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI是新兴快速发展的技术，对工作者、企业和社会有重要影响。自2022年ChatGPT广泛发布以来，引发了广泛讨论，但存在许多不确定性和混淆，需要澄清相关问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人工智能理论框架，特别是机器学习分支下的生成式AI理论，包括其生成人类类似输出的能力。
AI.method: 概念性综述方法，对生成式AI进行概述性分析，澄清关键问题，分类讨论应用领域。
AI.findings: 生成式AI与传统AI的主要区别在于不仅能分析数据还能生成类似人类的输出；其输出可分为语言型、视觉型、听觉型和多模态型；在客户服务、销售营销、金融、医疗、教育、游戏和运营等多个领域有应用；面临程序设计、技术限制、伦理法律等挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 澄清了生成式AI的概念框架，区分了其与传统AI的本质差异，建立了生成式AI输出分类体系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为商业领域提供了生成式AI应用的清晰指南，识别了各行业的潜在应用场景，指出了实施过程中需要注意的技术和伦理挑战。

title: Analysis of the Russian Current Economic Policy in the Context of Economic Sovereignty
affiliations: Moscow State Institute of International Relations (MGIMO-University)

detail.title: Analysis of the Russian Current Economic Policy in the Context of Economic Sovereignty
detail.abstract: The logic of modern Russian medium-term and long-term policy is determined by Federal Law No. 172-FZ of 2014 "On Strategic Planning in the Russian Federation". The definition and main measures to achieve economic sovereignty are contained in the "Strategy of Economic Security of the Russian Federation for the Period up to 2030".

AI.tldr: 该论文分析俄罗斯联邦2014年《战略规划法》和《2030年前俄罗斯联邦经济安全战略》如何塑造俄罗斯中长期政策逻辑，特别是经济主权目标的实现路径。
AI.research_question: 俄罗斯中长期政策逻辑如何通过《战略规划法》和《经济安全战略》框架来定义和实现经济主权？
AI.motivation: 理解俄罗斯在现代国际环境下的政策制定框架，特别是经济主权作为国家安全核心要素的战略重要性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 战略规划理论、经济主权理论、国家安全理论、制度主义理论
AI.method: 政策文本分析、法律框架分析、战略文件解读、比较制度分析
AI.findings: 俄罗斯通过《战略规划法》建立了系统化的中长期政策制定框架，《经济安全战略》明确了经济主权的定义和实现路径，两者共同构成了俄罗斯应对国际挑战的政策基础。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了战略规划与国家安全关系的理论框架，提出了经济主权作为现代国家战略核心要素的理论模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解俄罗斯政策制定逻辑提供了分析框架，为研究俄罗斯经济安全战略提供了具体路径，为国际关系学者和政策制定者提供了俄罗斯战略思维的解读工具。

title: Once Burned: Retail Crowd Behavior and Asymmetric Learning After Collective Market Losses

detail.title: Once Burned: Retail Crowd Behavior and Asymmetric Learning After Collective Market Losses
detail.abstract: We study retail investor crowd behavior following the COVID-19 market crash of February–March 2020, exploiting cross-sectional variation in collective retail losses to test whether prior crash losses distort how retail crowds process subsequent return signals. Using daily Robinhood popularity data combined with stock-level data, we construct a retail loss intensity measure that captures both the breadth of pre-crash retail ownership and the severity of the price decline experienced during the crash. We document a strong baseline asymmetry in retail crowd behavior: investors increase holdings in appreciating stocks but exit declining stocks at nearly twice the rate. More importantly, prior crash losses amplify this asymmetry in a manner consistent with a behavioral scarring effect — retail crowds become approximately three times more sensitive to subsequent negative return signals than to positive ones in high-loss stocks. This asymmetric learning pattern is concentrated in stocks with the highest pre-crash retail ownership, with null results in lower ownership quintiles serving as natural placebo tests. Our findings extend the disposition effect literature to the crowd level, suggesting that collective loss experience creates persistent asymmetries in how retail investors update their trading behavior in response to new information.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了COVID-19市场崩盘后零售投资者群体的行为，发现前期亏损会放大投资者对后续负面回报信号的敏感性，形成行为"伤疤效应"。
AI.research_question: 前期市场崩盘造成的集体亏损是否会扭曲零售投资者群体对后续回报信号的处理方式？
AI.motivation: 理解COVID-19市场崩盘后零售投资者群体的行为模式，特别是集体亏损经历如何影响他们对后续市场信息的反应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 处置效应理论、行为金融学中的伤疤效应、群体行为理论。
AI.method: 使用Robinhood每日流行度数据结合股票层面数据，构建零售亏损强度指标，衡量崩盘前零售所有权的广度以及崩盘期间价格下跌的严重程度。
AI.findings: 1. 零售投资者群体行为存在显著不对称性：增持上涨股票，但以近两倍的速度退出下跌股票；2. 前期崩盘亏损会放大这种不对称性，在高亏损股票中，零售群体对后续负面回报信号的敏感性约为正面信号的三倍；3. 这种不对称学习模式主要集中在崩盘前零售所有权最高的股票中。
AI.theory_contributions: 将处置效应理论扩展到群体层面，表明集体亏损经历会在零售投资者处理新信息时产生持久的不对称性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解零售投资者群体行为提供了实证证据，对市场稳定性和投资者教育具有启示意义，有助于预测市场波动期间零售投资者的行为模式。

title: From Hierarchy to Humanity: uBuntu Leadership in Five African Countries and U.S Educational Contexts
affiliations: Pennsylvania State University, College of Education, Department of Education Policy Studies, Students

detail.title: From Hierarchy to Humanity: uBuntu Leadership in Five African Countries and U.S Educational Contexts
detail.abstract: Employing Krippendorff's content analysis, I analyzed 13 articles about uBuntu and educational leadership to comparatively consider how uBuntu is applied in educational settings in Rwanda, Nigeria, South Africa, Malawi, and the United States. The research question is: What are the similarities and differences in how uBuntu is applied in educational leadership? The comparative content analysis revealed: 1). uBuntu as Relational and Ethical Leadership, 2). Contrast with Western/Colonial Models, 3). Education and Leadership Transformation, 4). Gender, Inclusion, and Exclusion, 5). uBuntu and Social Justice / Healing. Therefore, this comparative paper strives to examine the differences and similarities uBuntu applications for educational leadership.

AI.tldr: 本文通过内容分析比较了卢旺达、尼日利亚、南非、马拉维和美国五个国家教育领导中uBuntu原则的应用异同，揭示了uBuntu作为关系型伦理领导、与西方/殖民模式的对比、教育领导转型、性别包容与排斥、以及社会正义/疗愈等五个核心主题。
AI.research_question: uBuntu在教育领导中的应用有哪些相似性和差异性？
AI.motivation: 比较不同国家（包括非洲国家和美国）教育领导中uBuntu原则的应用情况，理解这一非洲哲学在不同文化背景下的实践差异和共性。
AI.theoretical_framework: uBuntu哲学（非洲人文主义哲学）、关系型领导理论、伦理领导理论、后殖民理论、社会正义理论。
AI.method: 采用Krippendorff内容分析法，对13篇关于uBuntu与教育领导的文章进行内容分析，比较卢旺达、尼日利亚、南非、马拉维和美国五个国家的应用情况。
AI.findings: 比较内容分析揭示了五个核心主题：1) uBuntu作为关系型和伦理领导；2) 与西方/殖民模式的对比；3) 教育与领导转型；4) 性别、包容与排斥；5) uBuntu与社会正义/疗愈。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了uBuntu哲学在教育领导领域的理论应用，提供了跨文化比较视角，丰富了关系型领导和伦理领导理论，为后殖民教育研究提供了实证基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为教育领导者提供了基于uBuntu原则的领导实践参考，促进包容性教育环境建设，支持社会正义和教育疗愈，为跨文化教育领导培训提供依据。

title: Auxiliary Benefits and the Fiscal Sustainability of Social Security in an Aging Economy
affiliations: Otaru University of Commerce

detail.title: Auxiliary Benefits and the Fiscal Sustainability of Social Security in an Aging Economy
detail.abstract: This paper studies the impact of auxiliary benefits on the sustainability of Social Security in an aging economy. I develop a computable overlapping generations model with heterogeneous households in which individuals may be single or married, face marriage and divorce risks, and may become widowed, thereby explicitly incorporating auxiliary benefits into the analysis. Using the calibrated model, I simulate an aging economy to quantify the additional taxes required to sustain the Social Security system. The results show that auxiliary benefits significantly increase the fiscal burden and that the gap in required taxes between economies with and without auxiliary benefits widens as the population ages. This gap remains substantial even when the retirement age is raised. The analysis provides quantitative insights into the macroeconomic and fiscal effects of auxiliary benefits. Moreover, incorporating marriage and divorce risks is essential; otherwise, the fiscal impact of auxiliary benefits is overstated.

AI.tldr: 本文研究辅助福利对老龄化经济中社会保障可持续性的影响，发现辅助福利显著增加财政负担，且随着人口老龄化，有/无辅助福利的经济体所需税收差距扩大，即使提高退休年龄，这一差距仍然显著。
AI.research_question: 辅助福利如何影响老龄化经济中社会保障系统的可持续性？
AI.motivation: 随着人口老龄化加剧，社会保障系统面临财政压力，而辅助福利（如配偶福利、遗属福利等）可能进一步增加财政负担，但现有研究对此缺乏定量分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于异质性家庭的世代交叠模型，考虑个体可能单身或已婚、面临结婚和离婚风险、可能丧偶等家庭结构变化，将辅助福利明确纳入分析框架。
AI.method: 开发可计算的世代交叠模型，校准模型参数，模拟老龄化经济情景，量化维持社会保障系统所需的额外税收。
AI.findings: 1) 辅助福利显著增加财政负担；2) 随着人口老龄化，有/无辅助福利的经济体所需税收差距扩大；3) 即使提高退休年龄，这一差距仍然显著；4) 必须考虑结婚和离婚风险，否则会高估辅助福利的财政影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了包含家庭结构动态变化（结婚、离婚、丧偶）和辅助福利的世代交叠模型，为分析社会保障政策提供了更贴近现实的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了辅助福利对社会保障财政可持续性影响的定量评估，表明在人口老龄化背景下，辅助福利改革可能是必要的，同时强调了考虑家庭动态变化对准确评估政策影响的重要性。

title: The Capacity Geometry of Global Trade: Polynomial-Time Routing in N P -Hard Disruption Regimes
affiliations: and Leeds Beckett University - Leeds Business School

detail.title: The Capacity Geometry of Global Trade: Polynomial-Time Routing in N P -Hard Disruption Regimes
detail.abstract:
We develop a geometric and optimization-based framework for analyzing resilience in global trade networks under heterogeneous disruptions. The model formulates trade flows as a constrained network allocation problem, where capacity constraints define a high-dimensional feasibility region whose structure is deformed by exogenous shocks. We show that, in realistic large-scale networks, strict feasibility is generically unattainable, leading to the collapse of classical resilience metrics. To address this, we introduce a penalized capacity geometry that yields well-posed recovery solutions and admits a tractable mean-field interpretation. 
Theoretical results establish existence, stability, and convergence properties of the penalized formulation, while numerical experiments on scale-free networks demonstrate its empirical robustness. Monte Carlo simulations reveal a fundamental trade-off between recovery magnitude and efficiency, as well as the endogenous emergence of bottleneck structures that concentrate flow along critical edges. These findings provide a unified framework for quantifying systemic resilience in complex trade systems and highlight the importance of soft-constrained optimization in high-dimensional disrupted environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个几何和优化框架，用于分析异质冲击下全球贸易网络的韧性。模型将贸易流表述为约束网络分配问题，引入惩罚容量几何来处理严格可行性不可达的问题，建立了存在性、稳定性和收敛性理论，并通过数值实验揭示了恢复规模与效率之间的权衡关系。
AI.research_question: 如何在异质冲击下量化全球贸易网络的系统性韧性？当严格可行性在现实大规模网络中不可达时，如何构建稳健的恢复解决方案？
AI.motivation: 传统韧性指标在现实大规模贸易网络中面临挑战，因为严格可行性通常不可达，导致经典韧性指标崩溃。需要开发新的理论框架来处理高维扰动环境下的系统韧性分析。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 几何优化框架：将贸易流建模为约束网络分配问题
2. 惩罚容量几何：引入惩罚项处理严格可行性不可达问题
3. 平均场解释：提供可处理的平均场理论解释
4. 系统韧性理论：基于网络结构和容量约束的韧性分析框架
AI.method:
1. 理论建模：构建约束网络分配问题的几何优化框架
2. 理论分析：证明惩罚公式的存在性、稳定性和收敛性
3. 数值实验：在无标度网络上进行实证稳健性测试
4. 蒙特卡洛模拟：揭示恢复规模与效率的权衡关系，识别瓶颈结构
AI.findings:
1. 在现实大规模网络中，严格可行性通常不可达
2. 惩罚容量几何能够产生适定的恢复解决方案
3. 恢复规模与效率之间存在根本性权衡
4. 瓶颈结构会内生地出现，使流量集中在关键边上
5. 软约束优化在高维扰动环境中至关重要
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 建立了异质冲击下贸易网络韧性的统一几何优化框架
2. 提出了惩罚容量几何概念，解决了严格可行性不可达问题
3. 证明了惩罚公式的理论性质（存在性、稳定性、收敛性）
4. 提供了可处理的平均场理论解释
5. 发展了系统性韧性的量化理论
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为政策制定者提供了量化贸易网络韧性的实用工具
2. 识别关键瓶颈结构，帮助优化资源配置
3. 指导在恢复规模与效率之间做出权衡决策
4. 为复杂贸易系统的风险管理提供分析框架
5. 支持在高维扰动环境下的决策制定

title: Effectiveness of Trading Pauses: Evidence from the Tokyo Stock Exchange
affiliations: The University of Osaka and

detail.title: Effectiveness of Trading Pauses: Evidence from the Tokyo Stock Exchange
detail.abstract: We estimate the causal effect of single-stock trading pauses on market quality using tick-by-tick order book data from the Tokyo Stock Exchange (TSE). Our instrumental variable exploits the TSE's fixed yen-denominated triggering thresholds, which generate plausibly exogenous variation in the percentage distance to a trading pause across stocks with different price levels. Trading pauses significantly reduce post-event volatility, narrow quoted bid-ask spreads, and facilitate price discovery. Order-level analysis reveals the mechanism: during pauses, liquidity providers submit opposite-direction limit orders at aggressively priced levels that push the matching price toward reversal, generating the observed improvements. These effects are strongest for less frequently traded stocks, where incremental liquidity has the largest impact. However, the benefits are attenuated for highly volatile stocks with recent negative returns, particularly during broad market downturns.

AI.tldr: 本文利用东京证券交易所的逐笔订单簿数据，通过固定日元触发阈值的工具变量，估计了单股交易暂停对市场质量的因果效应。研究发现交易暂停能显著降低事后波动率、缩小买卖价差并促进价格发现，主要通过流动性提供者在暂停期间提交反向限价订单来实现。这些效应对交易不频繁的股票最强，但对近期负收益的高波动性股票（尤其在大盘下跌时）效果减弱。
AI.research_question: 单股交易暂停对市场质量（波动率、买卖价差、价格发现）的因果效应是什么？其作用机制如何？
AI.motivation: 交易暂停是重要的市场稳定机制，但其实际效果和机制缺乏因果证据。东京证券交易所的固定日元触发阈值提供了自然实验机会，可以识别交易暂停对市场质量的因果影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 市场微观结构理论、交易暂停机制理论、流动性提供者行为理论、价格发现理论
AI.method: 使用东京证券交易所的逐笔订单簿数据，采用工具变量方法。工具变量基于TSE的固定日元触发阈值，该阈值在不同价格水平的股票中产生外生变化，从而识别交易暂停的因果效应。同时进行订单层面的机制分析。
AI.findings: 1. 交易暂停显著降低事后波动率；2. 缩小报价买卖价差；3. 促进价格发现；4. 机制分析显示：流动性提供者在暂停期间提交反向限价订单，推动匹配价格向反转方向移动；5. 效应对交易不频繁的股票最强；6. 对近期负收益的高波动性股票（尤其在大盘下跌时）效果减弱。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次使用因果识别方法估计交易暂停对市场质量的影响；2. 揭示了交易暂停通过流动性提供者反向订单机制改善市场质量；3. 提供了交易暂停效果异质性的理论解释；4. 丰富了市场微观结构中关于交易暂停机制的理论认识。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为交易所设计交易暂停规则提供实证依据；2. 帮助监管机构评估市场稳定机制的有效性；3. 为投资者理解交易暂停后的市场行为提供指导；4. 对不同类型的股票（交易频率、波动性）提供差异化的政策建议。

title: The Aid Paradox: Why More Assistance Can Reduce Welfare
affiliations: and Consultant

detail.title: The Aid Paradox: Why More Assistance Can Reduce Welfare
detail.abstract: This paper develops a simple welfare framework showing that development assistance may reduce real household welfare in structurally rigid recipient economies. Aid operates as a sustained demand-side transfer. When firm entry and institutional adjustment are constrained, increased demand raises domestic prices faster than supply can expand. Incumbent producers capture rents, while households face a higher cost of consumption, generating a welfare reversal even when measured income rises. The model identifies a critical threshold for the elasticity of entry with respect to aid: aid improves welfare only if the supply response is sufficiently strong to offset the demand-driven increase in prices-a condition least likely to hold in economies receiving large and persistent aid flows. The mechanism differs from standard Dutch Disease accounts by operating through constrained entry and price-mediated redistribution rather than sectoral reallocation or growth effects and applies more broadly to sustained externally financed demand injections in low-adjustment environments.

AI.tldr: 援助可能降低受援国家庭实际福利：当企业进入和制度调整受限时，援助作为持续需求转移会推高国内价格，使生产者获利而家庭消费成本上升，导致福利下降。
AI.research_question: 发展援助在何种条件下会降低受援国家庭的实际福利？
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为援助能改善受援国福利，但现实中一些接受大量持续援助的经济体并未实现预期福利改善，需要解释这一现象。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于结构刚性经济体的福利分析框架，强调企业进入弹性和制度调整约束对援助效果的关键作用。
AI.method: 构建理论模型，分析援助作为持续需求转移对价格、供给和福利的影响，识别企业进入弹性阈值条件。
AI.findings: 当企业进入弹性低于临界阈值时，援助会推高国内价格，使生产者获利而家庭消费成本上升，导致实际福利下降；这一效应在接收大量持续援助的经济体中最可能出现。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了不同于荷兰病理论的新机制：通过受限的企业进入和价格中介的再分配，而非部门重新配置或增长效应；适用于低调整环境中的持续外部需求注入。
AI.practical_contributions: 为援助政策设计提供重要启示：需要考虑受援国的结构刚性和企业进入能力；大规模持续援助可能适得其反；应关注供给侧响应能力的建设。

title: For Shorter or Poorer: Attitudes Toward the Trade-Off between Poverty and Morality
affiliations: World Bank, University of Antwerp - Institute of Development Policy and World Bank

detail.title: For Shorter or Poorer: Attitudes Toward the Trade-Off between Poverty and Morality

declarations.funderStatement: We acknowledge financial support from a World Bank’s RSB funding (P501403)

publicationDetails.journalName: Melbourne Institute of Applied Economic and Social Research Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: Many policy decisions involve trade-offs between lives and livelihoods. We provide the first estimates for a new welfare parameter that expresses this trade-off in the longevity-poverty space. To do so, we conduct randomized survey experiments with 20,000 respondents across seven middle-and high-income countries. Both the median and mean responses imply that individuals are willing to spend no more than about two years in poverty to gain one additional year of life, sharply restricting the plausible range for this normative parameter. We show how these estimates can inform policy trade-offs related to long-run global development, pandemic responses, and climate change.

AI.tldr: 该研究首次量化了寿命与贫困之间的权衡参数，通过跨国实验发现人们平均愿意用不超过2年贫困换取1年寿命增长
AI.research_question: 人们在寿命延长与贫困风险之间如何进行权衡？具体来说，愿意承受多少年的贫困来换取一年的寿命延长？
AI.motivation: 许多政策决策需要在生命与生计之间进行权衡（如公共卫生政策、气候变化应对、全球发展等），但缺乏量化的福利参数来指导这些决策
AI.theoretical_framework: 福利经济学中的权衡分析框架，将寿命与贫困作为两个关键的福利维度，建立规范性的权衡参数
AI.method: 在7个中高收入国家对20,000名受访者进行随机化调查实验，测量个体在寿命延长与贫困风险之间的权衡偏好
AI.findings: 中位数和平均数都显示，个体愿意用不超过约2年的贫困来换取1年的寿命延长，这为该规范性参数设定了狭窄的合理范围
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提出了量化寿命-贫困权衡的福利参数，为福利经济学提供了新的规范性分析工具
AI.practical_contributions: 为长期全球发展、疫情应对和气候变化等政策中的生命-生计权衡提供了实证依据和量化指导

title: From Insight to Action: Strategies for Cultural Transformation
affiliations: University of California, Berkeley

detail.title: From Insight to Action: Strategies for Cultural Transformation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: n/a
declarations.funderStatement: n/a

detail.abstract: This article examines how organizations can translate insights from cultural assessments into sustained, organization-wide transformation. Culture assessment must be embedded as an ongoing leadership discipline aligned with strategy rather than a reactive diagnostic tool and effective cultural transformation requires coordinated interventions across leadership behavior, talent systems, communication practices and organizational infrastructure. Key strategies include aligning leadership actions with desired values, embedding culture into hiring and onboarding, reinforcing norms through recognition and rewards, and equipping middle managers as culture carriers. Also important is psychological safety, continuous feedback and listening systems, continuous learning and alignment of policies, structures, and incentives with cultural objectives.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨组织如何将文化评估的洞察转化为持续的全组织转型，强调文化评估应作为与战略一致的管理常规而非被动诊断工具，并提出跨领导行为、人才系统、沟通实践和组织基础设施的协调干预策略。
AI.research_question: 组织如何将文化评估的洞察转化为持续的全组织转型？
AI.motivation: 许多组织进行文化评估但难以将评估结果转化为持续的组织变革，需要系统性方法将文化评估从被动诊断工具转变为与战略一致的管理常规。
AI.theoretical_framework: 组织文化变革理论、领导力理论、系统思维、心理安全理论、组织学习理论
AI.method: 概念性分析框架，基于文献综述和实践观察，提出文化转型的系统性方法
AI.findings: 有效的文化转型需要：1）将文化评估嵌入为持续的领导力常规；2）跨领导行为、人才系统、沟通实践和组织基础设施的协调干预；3）关键策略包括领导行为与价值观对齐、文化融入招聘和入职、通过认可和奖励强化规范、赋能中层管理者作为文化载体；4）心理安全、持续反馈系统、持续学习以及政策、结构和激励措施与文化目标的对齐至关重要。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了将文化评估从诊断工具转变为战略管理常规的理论框架，整合了领导力、系统变革和心理安全等多个理论视角，为文化转型研究提供了系统性分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为管理者提供了具体的实施策略：领导行为示范、文化融入人才管理、中层管理者赋能、建立反馈系统、政策激励对齐等，帮助组织将文化评估转化为实际变革行动。

title:
Happiness-Oriented Technology Platforms
A Novel Design Paradigm for Behavioral and Relational Computing
affiliations: Stanford University

detail.title:
Happiness-Oriented Technology Platforms
A Novel Design Paradigm for Behavioral and Relational Computing
detail.abstract: Digital platforms currently prioritize engagement over human flourishing. This paper proposes Happiness-Oriented Technology Platforms (HOTPs), a paradigm where system architecture explicitly promotes positive psychological states and relational trust. Drawing on flow theory and the Day Reconstruction Method, we argue that achieving flourishing requires relocating behavioral data capture from the application to the operatingsystem layer (or an intermediate operating layer). We present PlatOne-a behavioral operating layer-and Luanto, a domain-specific instantiation for tenant-landlord relationships. Together, they constitute a proof-ofconcept for the HOTP paradigm, with significant implications for platform design, digital well-being policy, and the future of organizational information systems.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出幸福导向技术平台（HOTPs）新范式，将系统架构从追求用户参与转向促进积极心理状态和关系信任。通过开发PlatOne行为操作系统层和Luanto租户-房东关系应用，为HOTP范式提供概念验证。
AI.research_question: 如何设计数字平台系统架构，使其从优先考虑用户参与转向明确促进人类繁荣和积极心理状态？
AI.motivation: 当前数字平台过度关注用户参与度，忽视了人类繁荣和心理健康，需要新的技术范式来促进积极心理状态和关系信任。
AI.theoretical_framework: 心流理论（Flow Theory）和日重建法（Day Reconstruction Method）为理论基础，强调积极心理体验和行为数据的系统性捕捉。
AI.method: 提出HOTP范式，开发PlatOne行为操作系统层作为中间层，并在租户-房东关系领域创建Luanto应用作为具体实例，进行概念验证。
AI.findings: 通过将行为数据捕捉从应用层转移到操作系统层（或中间操作层），可以创建促进人类繁荣的平台架构，PlatOne和Luanto的成功实现证明了HOTP范式的可行性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出HOTP新范式，将平台设计从参与度导向转向幸福导向；2）引入行为操作系统层概念；3）整合心流理论和日重建法到平台架构设计中。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为平台设计者提供促进数字幸福的具体架构方案；2）为数字幸福政策制定提供技术基础；3）为组织信息系统未来发展指明新方向；4）提供可实施的租户-房东关系应用实例。

title: Aging at the Very Top
affiliations: University of Bonn, Princeton University - Department of Economics and University of Bonn

detail.title: Aging at the Very Top
detail.abstract:
This paper documents that the age at which CEOs are appointed has risen sharply over the past several decades. Using newly assembled data covering a wide set of firms, we show that this increase is concentrated outside the largest listed firms and driven primarily by longer and more diverse external career paths prior to CEO appointment. These patterns are difficult to reconcile with explanations based on demographics, schooling, or tenure, and are instead consistent with a matching framework in which rising demand for generalist human capital leads firms to trade off peak ability for accumulated experience. We investigate the forces behind this shift. Using variation in consulting networks, we establish that firms place greater weight on diversified managerial experience as operating environments have become increasingly uncertain and complex. We also provide evidence for a supply-side response in which prospective CEOs broaden their skill portfolio as demand for generalist skills rises.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 研究发现过去几十年CEO任命年龄显著上升，主要原因是CEO任命前需要更长时间和更多样化的外部职业经历。这种趋势源于企业对通才型人力资本需求的增加，企业愿意用巅峰能力换取积累的经验。
AI.research_question: 为什么CEO任命年龄在过去几十年显著上升？这种趋势背后的驱动因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 观察到CEO任命年龄的显著上升趋势，需要解释这一现象背后的原因，特别是为什么企业更倾向于任命年龄更大、经验更丰富的CEO。
AI.theoretical_framework: 匹配框架理论：企业面临对通才型人力资本需求的上升，需要在巅峰能力和积累经验之间进行权衡。随着运营环境变得更加不确定和复杂，企业更看重多样化的管理经验。
AI.method: 使用新收集的广泛企业数据进行分析，通过咨询网络的变化来识别运营环境不确定性和复杂性对CEO任命标准的影响，同时考察供需双方的响应机制。
AI.findings: 1. CEO任命年龄显著上升，主要集中在大公司之外的企业；2. 主要驱动因素是CEO任命前需要更长、更多样化的外部职业路径；3. 这种趋势不能用人口统计、教育或任期解释；4. 运营环境不确定性和复杂性增加导致企业更看重多样化管理经验；5. 潜在的CEO也在扩大技能组合以应对通才技能需求的上升。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了匹配框架来解释CEO任命年龄上升现象；2. 将通才型人力资本需求与CEO任命标准变化联系起来；3. 解释了企业如何在巅峰能力和积累经验之间进行权衡。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为企业CEO选拔提供决策参考；2. 帮助潜在CEO规划职业发展路径；3. 为商学院教育提供课程设计依据；4. 为人力资源管理者提供人才评估框架。

title: Taxing the Task: Automated Production, Fiscal Exposure, and the Case for Task-Level Taxation
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Taxing the Task: Automated Production, Fiscal Exposure, and the Case for Task-Level Taxation
detail.abstract:
Modern fiscal systems are built on a foundational assumption: that economic production is organized around human labor, and that wages constitute a stable, observable tax base. This assumption is increasingly untenable. As artificial intelligence and robotics mature, production will be reorganized around automated task execution—a continuous, ambient process that operates outside the event-driven architecture of payroll taxation. This paper argues that the appropriate fiscal response is not a tax on robots as capital goods, but a recurring tax on automated task execution—the marginal unit at which machines substitute for human labor.

Drawing on the task-based production framework of Acemoglu and Restrepo (2019, 2020), this paper develops a formal model in which a per-task tax on automated production shifts the automation threshold, generates a hump-shaped revenue function, and serves as an automatic fiscal stabilizer as the wage base erodes. The model yields an optimal differentiated rate structure grounded in task-level substitution elasticity and Pigouvian externality pricing, providing theoretical justification for graduated rate bands across task categories.

The paper further argues that task-level taxation addresses a deeper institutional gap: the absence of fiscal infrastructure for ambient economic processes. Just as advertising monetized the continuous attention captured by social media platforms, the task tax makes continuous automated production legible to the state. This framing extends naturally to developing economies, where task taxation may enable fiscal leapfrogging—formalizing robotic production in contexts where payroll infrastructure never existed. Implementation architecture, behavioral design, privacy-preserving enforcement mechanisms, and a human task credit system are discussed.

AI.tldr: 本文提出对自动化任务执行征税，而非对机器人本身征税，以应对AI和机器人技术发展导致工资税基侵蚀的问题。该任务税基于任务替代弹性，可作为自动财政稳定器，并为发展中国家提供财政跨越机会。
AI.research_question: 在AI和机器人技术导致传统工资税基侵蚀的背景下，如何设计适应自动化生产的财政制度？
AI.motivation: 现代财政体系基于人类劳动组织生产的假设，但随着AI和机器人技术成熟，生产将围绕自动化任务执行重新组织，传统工资税基变得不稳定，需要新的税收基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Acemoglu和Restrepo（2019，2020）的任务型生产框架，结合庇古外部性定价理论和任务替代弹性概念。
AI.method: 建立形式化模型，分析每任务自动化生产税如何影响自动化阈值、产生驼峰形收入函数，并作为自动财政稳定器。
AI.findings: 任务级税收能够转移自动化阈值，产生驼峰形收入函数，基于任务替代弹性和庇古外部性定价的最优差异化税率结构，为不同任务类别的分级税率提供理论依据。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出任务税作为应对工资税基侵蚀的财政解决方案；2）建立形式化模型分析任务税的经济效应；3）为分级税率结构提供理论依据；4）扩展财政基础设施概念至环境经济过程。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为政府提供适应自动化经济的税收工具；2）为发展中国家提供财政跨越机会；3）提出实施架构、行为设计、隐私保护执行机制和人类任务信用系统等具体实施方案。

title: How Doctrine Texts Shape Distributed Leadership in High-Pressure Unmanned Environments：A Multi-Layer Semantic-Organizational-Training Analysis of an FPV Countermeasure Manual
affiliations: The University of Western Australia

detail.title: How Doctrine Texts Shape Distributed Leadership in High-Pressure Unmanned Environments：A Multi-Layer Semantic-Organizational-Training Analysis of an FPV Countermeasure Manual
detail.abstract: This study reconceptualizes Enemy Tactics for Using FPV Drones (with diagrams) and its associated countermeasures not merely as a tactical handbook, but as an organizational-cognitive mechanism through which leadership is codified, distributed, and normalized in practice. It addresses three closely connected questions: how doctrinal discourse organizes roles, prescribes actions, and defines constraints; how risk warnings, training requirements, and coordination norms are translated into signals of distributed leadership; and how textual discipline shapes organizational sensemaking, micro-level coordination, and the development of leadership capabilities.Methodologically, the study integrates directed content analysis, ruleenhanced sentence-function classification, semantic-cluster validation, and heterogeneous knowledge-graph modelling, using the 32-page FPV manual as its sole primary corpus. To ensure auditability, the datageneration pipeline is specified in eight stages: text extraction, cleaning, dual-level segmentation, codingontology construction, researcher coding, machine-assisted review, figure production, and alternativeexplanation auditing. The findings show that, at the first-order semantic level, the manual is dominated by countermeasure governance, technological capability, and organizational coordination, while at the sentencefunction level it is weighted most heavily toward description, command, and coordination. The Leadership Signal Index further suggests that the text privileges role allocation and behavioral discipline over heroic individual leadership, whereas psychological regulation and training density, although weaker in frequency terms, carry disproportionate interpretive significance. On this basis, the study proposes a four-stage mechanism-technological pressure, textual discipline, coordinative internalization, and distributed leadership formation-and argues that leadership development in high-pressure unmanned environments begins not with the expansion of personal charisma, but with the institutional internalization of perceptual responsibility, role coupling, alert obligations, and disciplinary structure that doctrine text preconfigures.

AI.tldr: 该研究将FPV无人机战术手册重新概念化为组织认知机制，探讨文本如何编码、分配和规范化领导力，而非仅仅是战术指南。
AI.research_question:
1. 教义话语如何组织角色、规定行动和定义约束？
2. 风险警告、训练要求和协调规范如何转化为分布式领导力信号？
3. 文本纪律如何塑造组织意义建构、微观协调和领导能力发展？
AI.motivation: 将战术手册从单纯的战术指南重新概念化为组织认知机制，理解在高压无人环境中领导力如何通过文本制度化和内部化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 组织认知理论、分布式领导理论、文本纪律理论、意义建构理论
AI.method: 整合定向内容分析、规则增强的句子功能分类、语义聚类验证和异构知识图谱建模，以32页FPV手册为唯一主要语料库。数据生成管道包括八个阶段：文本提取、清洗、双级分割、编码本体构建、研究者编码、机器辅助审查、图表生成和替代解释审计。
AI.findings:
1. 一阶语义层面：手册以对策治理、技术能力和组织协调为主
2. 句子功能层面：以描述、命令和协调为主
3. 领导力信号指数：文本优先考虑角色分配和行为纪律而非个人英雄式领导
4. 心理调节和训练密度虽然频率较低，但具有不成比例的解释意义
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了四阶段机制：技术压力→文本纪律→协调内部化→分布式领导力形成；论证了高压无人环境中的领导力发展始于制度化的感知责任、角色耦合、警戒义务和纪律结构的内部化，而非个人魅力的扩展。
AI.practical_contributions: 为军事组织提供了通过文本制度化和内部化发展分布式领导力的实践框架；展示了如何通过战术手册设计促进组织协调和领导能力发展。

title: Belief Dispersion and Entrepreneurial Entry
affiliations: University of Toronto - Rotman School of Management

detail.title: Belief Dispersion and Entrepreneurial Entry
detail.abstract:
When should a founder act on a strong belief about an opportunity, knowing that rivals assessing the same opportunity may hold very different views? This paper studies entry decisions when entrepreneurs hold heterogeneous beliefs about an opportunity's value and each founder knows only the range of views rivals might hold. In equilibrium, a founder enters only when their conviction exceeds a threshold set by anticipated rival optimism. The relationship between belief dispersion and entry is surprisingly rich: depending on the founder's conviction and the cost of entry, there may be no level of dispersion that supports entry, all levels may support it, or only a middle range may, so that an outside observer may see the most entry at intermediate levels of belief dispersion. When founders can delay, high dispersion that deters immediate entry need not prevent it altogether: the absence of rival action gradually reveals that competitors are less bullish than feared. Finally, not all conviction-building is equal. Validation that only the founder sees strengthens entry incentives fully, whereas validation visible to the whole market partly backfires by encouraging rivals. The paper formalises the intuition that entrepreneurial value comes not from optimism alone but from optimism that the founder anticipates rivals will not share, and derives predictions linking belief dispersion to entry patterns.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 研究创业者面对机会时，如何在自身信念与竞争对手信念存在差异的情况下做出进入决策。发现信念分散程度与进入决策的关系复杂：有时中等程度的信念分散最能促进进入，而创始人可以通过延迟进入来观察竞争对手的反应。
AI.research_question: 创业者何时应该基于自己对机会的强烈信念采取行动，即使知道竞争对手对同一机会可能有完全不同的看法？
AI.motivation: 创业者经常面临这样的困境：他们对自己的商业机会有强烈信念，但不知道竞争对手如何看待同一机会。这种信念差异如何影响进入决策是一个重要但尚未充分研究的问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于博弈论框架，分析异质信念下的战略进入决策。核心理论是创业价值不仅来自乐观，更来自创始人预期竞争对手不会分享的乐观。
AI.method: 理论建模方法，构建博弈论模型分析异质信念下的进入决策均衡。考虑信念分散程度、进入成本、延迟选项等因素。
AI.findings: 1. 创始人只在自身信念超过由预期竞争对手乐观程度设定的阈值时进入；2. 信念分散与进入的关系复杂：可能没有分散程度支持进入、所有分散程度都支持进入，或只有中等分散程度支持进入；3. 延迟进入可以缓解高分散度的阻碍作用；4. 只有创始人可见的验证能完全增强进入激励，而市场可见的验证可能适得其反。
AI.theory_contributions: 形式化了"创业价值来自创始人预期竞争对手不会分享的乐观"这一直觉，建立了信念分散与进入模式的理论联系，丰富了异质信念下的战略决策理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为创业者提供了决策框架：如何评估自身信念与竞争对手信念的差异，何时应该立即进入或延迟观察，以及如何理解不同类型的验证对进入决策的影响。

title: Information Treatments, Hypotheticals, and Event Studies: Comparative Estimates
affiliations: University of Texas at Austin, European Central Bank (ECB) - Directorate General Research, University of Macau and University of Reading

detail.title: Information Treatments, Hypotheticals, and Event Studies: Comparative Estimates
detail.abstract:
We study how consumer expectations respond to monetary policy announcements using a two-wave survey experiment around the September 2025 FOMC meeting. We compare three commonly used approaches to identifying causal effects on expectations: hypothetical ("vignette’’) scenarios, randomized control trials, and event studies. All three identification strategies yield qualitatively similar results: a rate cut reduces short- and long-run inflation expectations, raises expectations of economic activity, and lowers unemployment expectations. The estimated magnitudes are similar across the randomized controlled trial and event-study approaches, but relatively larger for vignette-based measures. Within-respondent comparisons further show that individuals who revise their expectations more in response to vignette scenarios also exhibit larger revisions following actual policy announcements and experimental information treatments.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过2025年9月FOMC会议前后的两波调查实验，比较了三种识别货币政策公告对消费者预期因果效应的方法：假设情景、随机对照试验和事件研究。三种方法都显示降息会降低通胀预期、提高经济活动预期、降低失业预期，但假设情景法的估计幅度更大。
AI.research_question: 货币政策公告如何影响消费者预期？不同因果识别方法（假设情景、随机对照试验、事件研究）在估计货币政策对消费者预期影响时是否产生一致结果？
AI.motivation: 理解货币政策如何影响消费者预期对宏观经济政策制定至关重要，但现有研究使用不同的因果识别方法，需要比较这些方法的一致性和可靠性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于货币政策传导机制理论，特别是预期渠道理论，研究货币政策公告如何通过改变消费者预期影响经济行为。
AI.method: 采用两波调查实验设计，围绕2025年9月FOMC会议，比较三种因果识别方法：假设情景法（vignette）、随机对照试验（RCT）和事件研究法。
AI.findings: 1. 三种方法都显示降息会降低短期和长期通胀预期，提高经济活动预期，降低失业预期；2. 随机对照试验和事件研究的估计幅度相似，但假设情景法的估计幅度相对更大；3. 个体层面分析显示，对假设情景反应更大的个体，在实际政策公告和实验信息处理中也表现出更大的预期修正。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为货币政策预期渠道提供了实证证据；2. 比较了不同因果识别方法在预期研究中的表现，为方法论选择提供指导；3. 验证了不同识别策略在定性结果上的一致性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了货币政策影响消费者预期的具体证据；2. 帮助研究人员选择适当的因果识别方法；3. 对央行沟通策略有启示意义，特别是如何有效管理公众预期。

title: The Architecture of Leverage: Structural Concentration and Competitive Moats in the AI Compute Supply Chain

detail.title: The Architecture of Leverage: Structural Concentration and Competitive Moats in the AI Compute Supply Chain

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests related to the companies or institutions discussed in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study does not involve human participants, patient data, or experiments. All analyses are based on publicly available secondary sources such as regulatory filings, earnings call transcripts, patent databases, and industry reports. As such, formal ethics committee approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not‑for‑profit sectors. The work was conducted independently by the author as part of ongoing research on the economics of AI hardware supply chains.

detail.abstract:
The global artificial intelligence hardware ecosystem is frequently reduced to a GPU-centric narrative. This paper argues that such framing obscures the true architecture of competitive advantage in the AI compute supply chain. Through systematic analysis of regulatory filings (SEC Forms 20-F and 10-K), earnings call transcripts, patent portfolio data, and primary industry data, this paper maps the power dynamics across three foundational layers: advanced packaging (CoWoS), high-bandwidth memory (HBM), and advanced substrate materials (ABF). We introduce a three-tier taxonomy — Class A (genuine pricing power), Class B (capped cyclical upside), and Class C (narrative exposure without structural position) — grounded in four structural criteria and operationalized through a replicable composite scoring instrument, the Irreplaceability Index (IRI): technology scarcity, supply concentration, customer qualification barriers, and replacement cycle length. Quantitative analysis of TSMC's NT$291 billion customer prepayment liability (FY2024 20-F), SK Hynix's architectural lock-in via HBM4 customer-specific logic die design, and Ajinomoto's 95%+ ABF material market share demonstrates that value in the AI stack concentrates at nodes of irreplaceability, not nodes of revenue scale. 
This expanded version extends the analysis in three dimensions. First, a full vertical analysis maps the upstream equipment layer (ASML, Applied Materials, Lam Research) and downstream substrate and OSAT tiers, providing a complete profit distribution topology anchored in FY2025 financial data. Second, a patent portfolio analysis characterizes three structurally distinct IP moat types across the three Class A nodes, drawing on LexisNexis PatentSight data, KnowMade hybrid bonding landscape analysis, and KIPRO institutional research — with the finding that SK Hynix's operational dominance in HBM is not matched by foundational legal protection in hybrid bonding, the critical technology for HBM4 and HBM5. Third, the demand origination structure is analyzed through the lens of $600+ billion in annual hyperscaler capital expenditure commitments for 2026, establishing the demand transmission mechanism and time-delay structure that propagates through the supply chain vertical.
The paper further stress-tests these moats against four disruption vectors — algorithmic memory compression (TurboQuant), HBM demand reversal mechanics, geopolitical concentration in Taiwan, and the material science transition toward glass substrates — and concludes that while current Class A moats are structurally robust through approximately 2027–2028, each carries identifiable expiration conditions with measurable milestone timelines.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了AI硬件生态系统的GPU中心论，通过系统分析揭示了AI计算供应链中竞争优势的真正架构。研究发现价值集中在不可替代性节点而非收入规模节点，并提出了基于技术稀缺性、供应集中度、客户认证壁垒和替换周期长度的三层分类法和不可替代性指数(IRI)。
AI.research_question: AI计算供应链中竞争优势的真正架构是什么？价值在AI堆栈中如何分配和集中？
AI.motivation: 当前全球AI硬件生态系统被简化为GPU中心论，这种框架掩盖了AI计算供应链中竞争优势的真实架构，需要更系统性地分析供应链各层的权力动态。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于技术稀缺性、供应集中度、客户认证壁垒和替换周期长度四个结构标准，提出三层分类法（A类-真正的定价权、B类-有上限的周期性上升、C类-无结构地位的叙事暴露）和不可替代性指数(IRI)。
AI.method: 系统分析监管文件（SEC表格20-F和10-K）、财报电话会议记录、专利组合数据和主要行业数据。采用定量分析（如台积电的客户预付款负债）、专利组合分析（LexisNexis PatentSight数据）和需求结构分析（超大规模企业资本支出承诺）。
AI.findings: 1. 价值集中在不可替代性节点而非收入规模节点；2. SK海力士在HBM的操作优势未转化为混合键合技术的法律保护；3. 当前A类护城河在2027-2028年前结构稳健，但都有可识别的到期条件和可测量的里程碑时间线。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出AI计算供应链的三层分类法和不可替代性指数(IRI)；2. 识别三种结构不同的IP护城河类型；3. 建立需求传导机制和时间延迟结构模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为投资者提供评估AI硬件供应链公司价值的分析框架；2. 为企业识别竞争优势和脆弱性提供工具；3. 为政策制定者理解供应链风险提供参考；4. 预测了四种破坏向量对当前护城河的影响。

title: Why Academia Can Never be "Just A Job" (And Why That is Actually Okay)
